warrior_heroes1_start_end.name: warrior
warrior_heroes1_start_end.text: When we catch this guy, I'm going to give him a big ... big piece of my mind.

warrior_heroes1_start_end.name: warrior
warrior_heroes1_start_end.text: Wish I could punch him. Hard.

warrior_heroes1_call.name: warrior
warrior_heroes1_call.text: This place is so huge. How am I going to find the others?

warrior_heroes1_call.name: warrior
warrior_heroes1_call.text: Seems I'm on my own for now. Let's go.

heroes_warrior_gate.name: warrior
heroes_warrior_gate.text: Oh, one of these. Stay out of my way, you stupid ... energy.

heroes_warrior_mistrust.name: warrior
heroes_warrior_mistrust.text: We did really need the job, but I should have said something anyway.

heroes_warrior_mistrust.name: warrior
heroes_warrior_mistrust.text: Magistrate Reynard felt slimy from the beginning.

heroes_warrior_mistrust.name: magistrate
heroes_warrior_mistrust.text: I'm not slimy, good sir Valens; I'm merely ... ulterior.

heroes_warrior_mistrust.name: magistrate
heroes_warrior_mistrust.text: Come, Ratleigh. If you're to assume my duties here, I have much more to show you. Behind the scenes.

heroes_warrior_where_is_tif.name: warrior
heroes_warrior_where_is_tif.text: When we came through during the appraisal, Tif loved this hall.

thief_first.name: thief
thief_first.text: Isidore! Valens! Seems I'm on my own for now.

thief_first.name: thief
thief_first.text: This place is a fair bit scarier without friends.

heroes1_5.name: thief
heroes1_5.text: Sometimes I feel like I'm being watched. It's creepy, but,

heroes1_5.name: thief
heroes1_5.text: maybe a little nice? Someone cares about me!

heroes_tif_so_much_space.name: thief
heroes_tif_so_much_space.text: So many odd-shapen courts; The architect's mind must have been a maze. My sort of fellow!

heroes_tif_lone_crystal.name: thief
heroes_tif_lone_crystal.text: Come along, crystal friend, we've somewhere you need to go.

heroes_tif_return.name: thief
heroes_tif_return.text: We'll be back for you. Don't worry.

heroes1_thief_three_crystals_end.name: thief
heroes1_thief_three_crystals_end.text: We'll pull you out of this.

heroes1_wizard_1.name: wizard
heroes1_wizard_1.text: Still don't understand how I got out of there --

heroes1_wizard_1.name: wizard
heroes1_wizard_1.text: some kind of intervention from afar --

heroes1_wizard_2.name: wizard
heroes1_wizard_2.text: At least the Magistrate went crazy before the job --

heroes1_wizard_2.name: wizard
heroes1_wizard_2.text: If we'd moved all these crystals out, I'd have naught to work with now.

heroes1_wizard_three_crystals.name: wizard
heroes1_wizard_three_crystals.text: Tif and Valens can't be far. I was imprisoned but a few hours --

heroes1_wizard_three_crystals.name: wizard
heroes1_wizard_three_crystals.text: I'll find the Magistrate -- he'll explain himself.

heroes1_wizard_three_crystals_end.name: wizard
heroes1_wizard_three_crystals_end.text: That Magistrate. We were courteous and professional, and he was so incredibly rude.

heroes1_wizard_array_end.name: wizard
heroes1_wizard_array_end.text: Strangely cut, they felt lifelike, almost ... possessed.

heroes1_warrior_wizard.name: wizard
heroes1_warrior_wizard.text: I am glad you came along; it seems I can't get out my way.

heroes1_warrior_wizard.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_wizard.text: I can't get out my way either.

heroes1_warrior_wizard.name: magistrate
heroes1_warrior_wizard.text: Now, Ratleigh, observe the way they work together. There is a lesson in this.

heroes1_warrior_thief.name: thief
heroes1_warrior_thief.text: Of course, of course, shush, we've got to catch up to the Magistrate! Where's Izzy?

heroes1_warrior_thief.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_thief.text: He went the other way looking for you.

heroes1_warrior_thief.name: thief
heroes1_warrior_thief.text: Well, let's find him. Which other way?

heroes1_warrior_thief.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_thief.text: Yeah... there are a lot of Other Ways in here.

heroes1_warrior_thief_mid0.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_thief_mid0.text: Even when we find Izzy again, then what? We just leave, no harm done?

heroes1_warrior_thief_mid0.name: thief
heroes1_warrior_thief_mid0.text: I know where Magistrate Reynard is headed. We've got to catch up.

heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.name: thief
heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.text: We just need to keep headed East.

heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.text: Oh. Okay. How do you know that?

heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.name: thief
heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.text: When he locked us up, he'd already donned his dustcoat. For *travel*. And, about his neck...

heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.text: You were eyeing his jewelry. Of course.

heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.name: thief
heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.text: Had your eyes been open, you'd have seen a distinctive, *recognizable* leather cord, three-strand plaited, oiled and blackened...

heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_thief_mid.text: Oh! A key ... for a locker ... in The Crawler??

heroes1_warrior_thief_end.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_thief_end.text: Let's go get that stupid magistrate!

heroes1_warrior_thief_end.name: thief
heroes1_warrior_thief_end.text: Let's go get that ... I mean, he's not stupid though!

heroes1_warrior_thief_end.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_thief_end.text: I mean we don't like him!

heroes1_wizard_thief.name: thief
heroes1_wizard_thief.text: I told him we need to get out of this ... echoey lonely place, then head to the retrenchment.

heroes1_wizard_thief.name: thief
heroes1_wizard_thief.text: The passengers' retrenchment. For the Crawler.

heroes1_wizard_thief.name: thief
heroes1_wizard_thief.text: *If* we get there before it leaves, we can stop him.

heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused.name: wizard
heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused.text: We were just giving him our estimate for the move -- as we'd agreed --

heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused.name: wizard
heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused.text: and slammo, he jails us. I still don't understand.

heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused.text: It would've been a far bigger job than he'd told me at the banquet.

heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused.text: Did he think we were exaggerating, trying to overbill?

heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused_mid.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused_mid.text: When he ordered his guards to seize us... Tif didn't seem surprised.

heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused_mid.name: wizard
heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused_mid.text: Come to think ... did she look a bit sheepish to you?

heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused_mid.name: warrior
heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused_mid.text: Not *sheep*ish. Is there an animal more guilty than a sheep?

heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused_mid.name: wizard
heroes1_warrior_wizard_confused_mid.text: A dog who dragged your big juicy leg of mutton off the table the moment you turned your back!

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.name: warrior
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.text: Tif. Open the bag. What did you do?

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.text: Well, you see, the Magistrate has been up to something.

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.name: warrior
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.text: Yeah, locking us up in his dungeon!

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.name: wizard
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.text: That could have been a misunderstanding.

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.name: wizard
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_optional.text: He locked us up ... because of you?

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.name: warrior
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.text: Tif ... why did the Magistrate order his guards to seize us?

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.text: Sometimes things just follow me home. Without me doing *anything*. You know how it is.

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.name: warrior
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.text: Following you home, in this case, was...?

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.text: Well, yeah, in a case... how did you ... hmmm. It was a fine leather-clad case, with satisfyingly grippable handles.

heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_first_time_mandator.text: I'd thought it might be full of shiny things, but it only held papers and notes.

heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.name: warrior
heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.text: He locked us up because you stole his case?

heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.text: At first I was disappointed. But then I realized,

heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.text: little notes tell you a lot about people, you know? Reading between the lines. So I took a little peek.

heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.text: We should have never taken this job, or maybe we should have -- as we did -- because if we didn't,

heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.text: we wouldn't know what we know, which is, we have to stop him... as soon as possible.

heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.name: thief
heroes_three_for_the_second_time_mandato.text: These crystals. We need to talk about ... how they're made.

heroes_jail.name: warrior
heroes_jail.text: That'll teach me to watch where I step.

heroes_jail.name: thief
heroes_jail.text: Traps everywhere. I really shouldn't be enjoying this.

heroes_jail.name: wizard
heroes_jail.text: Don't worry. Bars are no hard matter for me at all!

heroes_mouse.name: magistrate
heroes_mouse.text: Watch, Ratleigh, as we free the mouse, and he skitters through our maze.

heroes_jail2.name: warrior
heroes_jail2.text: You said bars were no hard matter...

heroes_jail2.name: thief
heroes_jail2.text: ... and tempted Providence! No bars this time!

heroes_jail2.name: magistrate
heroes_jail2.text: Indeed, no more bars for you, Gravy Sorcerer!

heroes_jail2.name: magistrate
heroes_jail2.text: Let us be off, Ratleigh, and leave them to ponder their mistakes... of which, there are so, SO many.

heroes_jail2.name: wizard
heroes_jail2.text: + magistrate_disappear Wait! You still haven't paid us for the appraisal!

heroes_jail2_mid.name: wizard
heroes_jail2_mid.text: He's high-enough ranked, he can command the Crawler to depart.

heroes_jail2_mid.name: wizard
heroes_jail2_mid.text: We're not likely to catch him.

heroes_jail2_mid.name: warrior
heroes_jail2_mid.text: There's another way across the Badlands.

heroes_jail2_mid.name: thief
heroes_jail2_mid.text: Valens, can you get us in with them?

heroes_jail2_mid.name: wizard
heroes_jail2_mid.text: Even if ... first day of the season isn't for two weeks yet.

heroes_jail2_mid2.name: wizard
heroes_jail2_mid2.text: If the King knew his head Magistrate's exceeding his charge,

heroes_jail2_mid2.name: wizard
heroes_jail2_mid2.text: crystalizing lesser nobles without rhyme nor reason...

heroes_jail2_mid2.name: wizard
heroes_jail2_mid2.text: he might consider it an emergency.

heroes_jail2_mid2.name: warrior
heroes_jail2_mid2.text: We can play it up a little, insinuate he's looking to usurp the throne.

heroes_jail2_mid2.name: thief
heroes_jail2_mid2.text: Ooh. Which he may really be!

heroes_jail2_mid2.name: thief
heroes_jail2_mid2.text: If I were the King, I'd send the Caravan immediately!

heroes_jail2_end.name: thief
heroes_jail2_end.text: The Caravan! I bet we'll meet all kinds of new friends.

heroes_jail2_end.name: wizard
heroes_jail2_end.text: After being stuck in this place, I'll enjoy travelling in luxury...

heroes_jail2_end.name: warrior
heroes_jail2_end.text: I've heard the food is good. They'll have plenty of gravy for you.

heroes_jail2_end.name: thief
heroes_jail2_end.text: Save the arguing for the King! Or the ... Lord Chamberlain, or whoever we can get to!

heroes2_warrior_goblins_1.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_goblins_1.text: Sore back, crick in my neck, two days without sleep,

heroes2_warrior_goblins_2.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_goblins_2.text: Was hoping that'd take me out, not further in.

heroes2_warrior_goblins_2_mid.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_goblins_2_mid.text: If I could still swing a sword, this would be a very different situation.

heroes2_warrior_goblins_2_mid_2.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_goblins_2_mid_2.text: If I'd a sword, we might've repelled those raiders, and they wouldn't have scattered the caravan.

heroes2_warrior_goblins_2_mid_2.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_goblins_2_mid_2.text: And I wouldn't even be here.

heroes2_warrior_goblins_2_end.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_goblins_2_end.text: Thank God to be out of there!

heroes2_thief_goblins.name: thief
heroes2_thief_goblins.text: We could all just get along nicely, couldn't we ... ?

heroes2_thief_goblins.name: magistrate
heroes2_thief_goblins.text: Witness, Ratleigh, the precarity in which our Heroine is now placed! Watch how she weaves.

heroes2_thief_goblins_mid.name: thief
heroes2_thief_goblins_mid.text: Those guards boasted that no foe could come within a day's march without being met in force.

heroes2_thief_goblins_mid.name: thief
heroes2_thief_goblins_mid.text: So how'd these Goblins get here? And why aren't they being repelled?

heroes2_wizard_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_goblins.text: I'd have thought the caravan's defenses would hold for longer, but,

heroes2_wizard_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_goblins.text: I'm glad to still be alive, hale body, hale mind.

heroes2_wizard_goblins_mid.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_goblins_mid.text: Don't know why they didn't like the word "hale".

heroes2_wizard_goblins_mid.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_goblins_mid.text: "Hale Heroes of Hauling" sounds upscale and smart.

heroes2_warrior_dragon_intro.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_dragon_intro.text: Town's been overrun. Caravan should have got moving sooner.

heroes2_warrior_dragon_intro.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_dragon_intro.text: I told them we needed to hurry.

heroes2_warrior_dragon_intro_end.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_dragon_intro_end.text: Here's hoping the others make it to the rally point.

heroes2_thief_dragons_intro.name: thief
heroes2_thief_dragons_intro.text: Hey there boy-os, I don't suppose anyone ever keeps you as pets?

heroes2_thief_dragons_intro.name: thief
heroes2_thief_dragons_intro.text: You could do all kinds of things! Warm the house, roast supper...

heroes2_thief_dragons_intro_2.name: thief
heroes2_thief_dragons_intro_2.text: keep the bath hot *well* into the night...

heroes2_thief_dragons_intro_3.name: thief
heroes2_thief_dragons_intro_3.text: dry the wash in half the time...

heroes2_thief_dragons_intro_5.name: thief
heroes2_thief_dragons_intro_5.text: scorch the weeds out between the paving stones...

heroes2_thief_dragons_intro_6.name: thief
heroes2_thief_dragons_intro_6.text: And if anyone comes collecting debts... ... ...

heroes2_thief_dragons_second.name: thief
heroes2_thief_dragons_second.text: Magistrate Reynard has been here, and not long ago.

heroes2_thief_dragons_third_end.name: thief
heroes2_thief_dragons_third_end.text: Is that the crack of a teleport I hear? Izzy, is that you?

heroes2_three_first.name: thief
heroes2_three_first.text: He tried to stop us, but he couldn't!

heroes2_three_first.name: warrior
heroes2_three_first.text: He? You think Reynard was behind the attack on the Caravan?

heroes2_three_first.name: thief
heroes2_three_first.text: Such an attack has hardly ever happened in history --

heroes2_three_first.name: warrior
heroes2_three_first.text: None dare; the Caravan's defenses are legendary!...

heroes2_three_first.name: thief
heroes2_three_first.text: So *someone* had a legendarily strong motive. Perhaps that motive involves us!

heroes2_three_first_mid.name: wizard
heroes2_three_first_mid.text: I'm surprised you weren't praying for an ambush.

heroes2_three_first_mid.name: wizard
heroes2_three_first_mid.text: Day after day of close-quartered travel, Guardsmen all around,

heroes2_three_first_mid.name: wizard
heroes2_three_first_mid.text: not much to occupy them but gossip in quiet whispers; well, *I* felt awkward for you.

heroes2_three_first_mid.name: warrior
heroes2_three_first_mid.text: Not at all. It's only the higher-ups who pretend to hate me. The regular guys on the line, they respect what I did.

heroes2_three_first_mid.name: thief
heroes2_three_first_mid.text: Izzy, can't you see how they looked at him? They all wanted to be him, ... and they were glad not to be him.

heroes2_warrior_monster_gate_first_end.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_monster_gate_first_end.text: Dumb energy box is no match for me!

heroes2_warrior_monster_gate_2_optional_.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_monster_gate_2_optional_.text: Thank God they didn't foresee I'd push crystals as a weapon.

heroes2_warrior_3monster.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_3monster.text: As long as the King keeps up his end of the deal, and orders my Swordbinding dispelled, this will all have been worth it.

heroes2_warrior_3monster_end.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_3monster_end.text: Can't wait to deliver this guy directly to the King.

heroes2_postmeetup_thief.name: thief
heroes2_postmeetup_thief.text: If I'd known that starting a moving company would lead to big adventures,

heroes2_postmeetup_thief.name: thief
heroes2_postmeetup_thief.text: I'd have talked them into it so much sooner!

heroes2_postmeetup_warrior.name: warrior
heroes2_postmeetup_warrior.text: Who'd have guessed that starting a moving company could get us into so much trouble.

heroes2_postmeetup_warrior.name: warrior
heroes2_postmeetup_warrior.text: And that getting into trouble could lead to a deal with the King. A path toward absolution!

heroes2_postmeetup_warrior.name: warrior
heroes2_postmeetup_warrior.text: But, who'd have guessed that a deal with the King would shunt us into *even worse* trouble.

heroes2_postmeetup_warrior.name: warrior
heroes2_postmeetup_warrior.text: Sometimes, the only way out is ... forward.

heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.name: wizard
heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.text: Had I known that starting a moving company would lead me into the East,

heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.name: wizard
heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.text: surrounded by foul creatures, nary a book brought with me,

heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.name: wizard
heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.text: I'd have started some company about being sedentary, instead.

heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.name: wizard
heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.text: Like ... Guards. But, guards that never have any trouble.

heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.name: wizard
heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.text: Casual guards, for buildings where nobody goes,

heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.name: wizard
heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.text: small, no walking, we just sit there.

heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.name: wizard
heroes2_postmeetup_wizard.text: Warming our feet by the fire.

heroes2_postmeetup_wizard_mid.name: wizard
heroes2_postmeetup_wizard_mid.text: Plenty of fires round here, I suppose. Not the sort I prefer, though.

heroes2_warrior_goblins_vs_dragon.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_goblins_vs_dragon.text: Oh, we're about to have some fun, aren't we?

heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.text: Magistrate Reynard flees to the East, and about the time he gets here, it's overrun by monsters.

heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.text: Possibility the First: It's a coincidence. Always an option, but let's not jump straight to that.

heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.text: Possibility the Second: He came East because this monster invasion was about to happen, and he knew.

heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.text: And he wants to stop it? Or, the opposite: he wants to take advantage in some way? Perhaps ... to what end?

heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.text: Possibility the Third: He caused all this. He is sowing pandemonium *intentionally*.

heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins.text: For what reason? Merely to throw us off his trail? That's a lot of chaos just for us.

heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins_end.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_per_turn_goblins_end.text: Thanks for helping me out, fella! And thank your friends for helping me think.

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.name: thief
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.text: A dirk is small. You could sneak it through?

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.name: warrior
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.text: Small won't help. The enchantment's not that dumb, Tif.

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.name: thief
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.text: Well, use a club? Clubs aren't sharp.

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.name: warrior
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.text: Tif, it's called "Swordbound" because we're Swordsmen.

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.name: warrior
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.text: But the binding isn't limited to blades.

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.name: warrior
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.text: I can't swing *anything* at *anyone*. Including a Goblin, sadly.

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.name: warrior
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional.text: I could push them sternly with my fist. Not going to help.

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional_.name: thief
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional_.text: See, when we work together, you don't even need a club!

heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional_.name: warrior
heroes2_one_fire_warrior_thief_optional_.text: Not today at least. Let's hope our luck holds.

heroes2_wizard_priestess_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_priestess_first.text: Why hello there! We seem to be in a spot of trouble.

heroes2_wizard_priestess_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_priestess_first.text: Normally, goblins are no problem for me, no problem at all, but, this passageway is so narrow...

heroes2_warrior_priestess_first.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_priestess_first.text: I'm so happy to have some help. Once-a-time I would have slain these goblins easily,

heroes2_warrior_priestess_first_end.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_priestess_first_end.text: Please travel with us. We're trying to stop a really bad guy.

heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.text: If we catch Magistrate Reynard, the King will order my Swordbinding lifted.

heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.text: And that will give me freedom to set my own path,

heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.text: rather than just cowering, and accepting whatever scraps are left me.

heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.text: Even if I never make my living by the sword again... it's the indignity of it, you know?

heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_priestess_second.text: The deal with the King aside, I'd capture this snakeweasel just on principle. He's left enough wreckage behind him already.

heroes2_warrior_priestess_second_end.name: warrior
heroes2_warrior_priestess_second_end.text: My meeting spot with my friend Tif is up ahead. You'll like her.

heroes2_thief_priestess_second.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second.text: ... and that's when we decided to finally start the company.

heroes2_thief_priestess_second.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second.text: We're all good at moving things in our own ways,

heroes2_thief_priestess_second.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second.text: and we'd gained so much experience at loading docks and so forth.

heroes2_thief_priestess_crawler.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_crawler.text: Do you know the Crawler? Valens and I worked there for a while. At the far other end of the route, I mean...

heroes2_thief_priestess_crawler.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_crawler.text: Until I ... Well, it was a fun job while we had it.

heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_warri.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_warri.text: Valens is incredibly strong. He said it's a trick, but the details are hard to talk about.

heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_warri.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_warri.text: Said he was taught by an older fellow, another soldier.

heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_disgr.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_disgr.text: Don't tell him I said "disgraced", haha!

heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_disgr.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_disgr.text: They have some official term for it. A neutral term.

heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_wizar.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_wizar.text: Izzy's swap powers are amazing. He got them in some kind of accident.

heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_wizar.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second_mid_wizar.text: Great for moving heavy stuff, not so great for getting close to people.

heroes2_thief_priestess_second_end.name: thief
heroes2_thief_priestess_second_end.text: I'm glad we had this time to talk!

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: Yes, we all fumble, we all trip, but have you ever noticed

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: that sometimes, we're clumsy in ways that are downright suspicious?

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: An example. You're holding a tray of carefully-arranged reagents, and, just as you've done a thousand times,

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: you're turning toward the workbench to tip some powders into a tincture --

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: the tray clatters to the floor.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: Oh, that'll take hours to re-grind.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: How hard could it have been just to keep the tray pinched firmly between thumb and fingers? Not hard at all, *obviously*. I do it all the time.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: Did some hidden part of me *want* to make a mess?

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: Or, have you ever -- the candles flickering romantically, the warmth of the air just so --

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: Well you didn't have to use the word "donkey", even if the sheen of her hairy, hairy legs --

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: *nice* hair, I mean, soft and lustrous --

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_first.text: "donkey", clumsy word, it didn't have to happen! It was like dropping the reagents, just like that.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_secon.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_secon.text: I just wonder if there's some mind behind the mind,

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_secon.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_secon.text: that uses such fumbles to redirect our lives, by injecting drama we think we don't want;

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_secon.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_secon.text: that hides itself away, cloaked in the guise of clumsiness.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_secon.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_secon.text: A background mind that creates misadventures just to steer us where it wants us.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: I was so careful, for so long. I was careful, I was careful, I was careful, I was careful, then ...

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: One day I woke up at 3 in the morning, full of energy, yearning to just do it all.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: *Enough* careful, years of being careful are making me old! It's time to just leap ahead.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: I was working feverishly, half-asleep, blearily...

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: The stone shimmering with power, vibrations through my fingers, coursing up my arm.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: No surprise, -- a mistake. and, I dropped it --

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: a flash, a report, tiny fragments shooting out, piercing --

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: and thus you see me today.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: Numerous and tiny, there's no removing them.

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: So it was an accident; but many a fool would love to do what I can do,

heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_and_priestess_alone_third.text: so perhaps it was no accident at all. May be I wrecked my life intentionally, a mind behind my mind.

heroes2_wizard_thief_priestess_goblins.name: thief
heroes2_wizard_thief_priestess_goblins.text: A Guardsman told me they all saw incredible smoke coming from the mountains, last week.

heroes2_wizard_thief_priestess_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_thief_priestess_goblins.text: There was a fire in the goblin caves? A huge accident? Or, -- maybe someone smoked them out intentionally...

heroes2_wizard_thief_priestess_goblins.name: thief
heroes2_wizard_thief_priestess_goblins.text: Then how'd the dragons get here? They don't mind smoke.

heroes2_wizard_thief_priestess_goblins.name: wizard
heroes2_wizard_thief_priestess_goblins.text: Maybe the dragons made the smoke...

heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.name: magistrate
heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.text: Observe, Ratleigh, how the complexities of this mechanism slow them,

heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.name: magistrate
heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.text: giving us time to bait the final trap. Let us be off.

heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.name: thief
heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.text: These Goblins don't take orders. How's he getting them into all the right places?

heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.name: wizard
heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.text: I've heard tell of exotic women who can enthrall monsters and men...

heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.name: thief
heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.text: Oh! May be he has one in his service!

heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.name: wizard
heroes2_thief_wizard_priestess_compartme.text: Or perhaps he has absorbed that power himself, as he did with that ... crystallization.

heroes2_four.name: magistrate
heroes2_four.text: Walls did not contain them, Ratleigh, so behold: we now put Dragons to this use.

heroes2_four.name: magistrate
heroes2_four.text: Fire will hold them, as we move onward to raise the final pillars of my design.

heroes2_four.name: warrior
heroes2_four.text: + magistrate_disappear 0.3 So you're telling me he's getting away from us *again*?

heroes2_four.name: thief
heroes2_four.text: I prefer to think of it as, we're closing in on him!

heroes2_four.name: thief
heroes2_four.text: Across the canyon, he'll be in a place where he has no friends,

heroes2_four.name: wizard
heroes2_four.text: Our status as emissaries of the King might also mean nothing.

heroes2_four.name: thief
heroes2_four.text: We'll be diplomats! They'll spread the carpets for us. The *nice* carpets!

heroes2_four.name: warrior
heroes2_four.text: Before we can step into our grand new careers, we'll have to get out of this trap.

heroes3_bard_first_end.name: bard
heroes3_bard_first_end.text: That's settled. Let's see if we can find one of these crystals.

heroes3_bard_second.name: bard
heroes3_bard_second.text: This used to be a nice place. A girl can hardly get around, now.

heroes3_bard_crystals_first.name: bard
heroes3_bard_crystals_first.text: At last! Let's see how they respond...

heroes3_bard_crystals_first_mid.name: bard
heroes3_bard_crystals_first_mid.text: It's true, they are filled with life. How can it be?

heroes3_bard_crystals_first_end.name: bard
heroes3_bard_crystals_first_end.text: Now, to find the man who's making this happen.

heroes3_bard_two_goblins.name: bard
heroes3_bard_two_goblins.text: I was hoping to find some *people* hereabouts.

heroes3_bard_warrior_first.name: bard
heroes3_bard_warrior_first.text: Hey fellow traveler, mind helping me move forward?

heroes3_bard_warrior_first.name: warrior
heroes3_bard_warrior_first.text: I ... uh ... yes, yes of course!

heroes3_bard_warrior_first_end.name: bard
heroes3_bard_warrior_first_end.text: A girl likes to be manhandled once in a while.

heroes3_bard_warrior_first_end.name: bard
heroes3_bard_warrior_first_end.text: But don't get used to it.

heroes3_bard_thief_first.name: thief
heroes3_bard_thief_first.text: So I found out he'd been crystalizing people,

heroes3_bard_thief_first.name: thief
heroes3_bard_thief_first.text: and he locked us in his dungeon. But we escaped, we told the King, the King deputized us, and now we're here.

heroes3_bard_thief_first.name: bard
heroes3_bard_thief_first.text: Brave of you to travel all this way, through chaos and calamity.

heroes3_bard_thief_first.name: bard
heroes3_bard_thief_first.text: And in such a savvy outfit!

heroes3_bard_thief_first.name: bard
heroes3_bard_thief_first.text: It shows you know how to make friends with all manner of folk.

heroes3_bard_thief_first.name: thief
heroes3_bard_thief_first.text: Awww. Thank you. Your dress is really pretty.

heroes3_bard_thief_mid.name: bard
heroes3_bard_thief_mid.text: This man who makes the crystals, what does he look like?

heroes3_bard_thief_mid.name: bard
heroes3_bard_thief_mid.text: Wearing typical garb of your people?

heroes3_bard_thief_mid.name: thief
heroes3_bard_thief_mid.text: Of the highest station! Great taste in clothes, really.

heroes3_bard_thief_mid.name: bard
heroes3_bard_thief_mid.text: Strange. That's not the description I've heard.

heroes3_bard_warrior_thief.name: thief
heroes3_bard_warrior_thief.text: Am I making you nervous, or is *she* making you nervous?

heroes3_bard_and_druid_first.name: druid
heroes3_bard_and_druid_first.text: So, you're the performer I've been hearing about.

heroes3_bard_and_druid_first.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_druid_first.text: And you're the famous Crystalmancer that I've been hearing about!

heroes3_bard_and_druid_first_end.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_druid_first_end.text: I don't call myself a 'performer'; it's more serious than that.

heroes3_bard_and_druid_second.name: druid
heroes3_bard_and_druid_second.text: You can handle this creature, yes?

heroes3_bard_and_priestess.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_priestess.text: I don't mean to be manipulative, not always, not in a *bad* way...

heroes3_bard_and_priestess_mid.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_priestess_mid.text: ... but over time, I caught glimpses. This person wants to be reached in this way. That person, that way.

heroes3_bard_and_priestess_mid.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_priestess_mid.text: When I get it *just* right ... they're happy for a minute.

heroes3_bard_and_priestess_mid.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_priestess_mid.text: Now ... this is just how I live.

heroes3_bard_and_priestess_end.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_priestess_end.text: Thanks for talking. I feel a little better about it.

heroes3_bard_and_wizard.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_wizard.text: It's amazing the way you just zip around!

heroes3_bard_and_wizard.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_wizard.text: You must be incredibly intelligent... I can't even imagine.

heroes3_bard_and_wizard.name: wizard
heroes3_bard_and_wizard.text: Well, it did take some doing.

heroes3_bard_and_wizard.name: wizard
heroes3_bard_and_wizard.text: But many people could do similar, if they really set their minds to it!

heroes3_bard_and_wizard_2.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_wizard_2.text: When you swap with me... it's exhilarating!

heroes3_bard_and_wizard_2.name: bard
heroes3_bard_and_wizard_2.text: First I feel tingly inside, then *pop!*, I'm somewhere else! And short of breath.

heroes3_bard_dragon_maze.name: bard
heroes3_bard_dragon_maze.text: Got to be quite wary with these, so my new friends said.

heroes3_four_with_dragon.name: magistrate
heroes3_four_with_dragon.text: I learned my lesson with you, pesky wizard.

heroes3_four_with_dragon.name: magistrate
heroes3_four_with_dragon.text: I've had my second-favorite son Ratleigh clear this area of anything you could possibly employ

heroes3_four_with_dragon.name: magistrate
heroes3_four_with_dragon.text: to weasel past this faithful Guard Dragon.

heroes3_four_with_dragon.name: magistrate
heroes3_four_with_dragon.text: No time to discuss! Soon I must away, via my ... special transport.

heroes3_four_with_dragon.name: magistrate
heroes3_four_with_dragon.text: We've a terrible paucity of time in which to finish impressing

heroes3_four_with_dragon.name: magistrate
heroes3_four_with_dragon.text: all the great multitude of your new duties into your tiny little head.

heroes3_druid_thief_first.name: druid
heroes3_druid_thief_first.text: Hail there! You look to be from the West.

heroes3_druid_thief_first.name: druid
heroes3_druid_thief_first.text: I'd been preparing to book passage to the West, myself, but my plans were just interrupted.

heroes3_druid_thief_first.name: druid
heroes3_druid_thief_first.text: No pleasure involved. Just looking for someone.

heroes3_druid_thief_crystal.name: thief
heroes3_druid_thief_crystal.text: Soooo, I suspect I know who you're looking for.

heroes3_druid_thief_first_end.name: thief
heroes3_druid_thief_first_end.text: Come, I've some friends you should meet.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_1.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_1.text: So. It is your charge to apprehend this man?

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_1.name: warrior
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_1.text: Yes; he will answer to the King.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_1.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_1.text: My charge is similar. Our Circle of Elders is ... quite angry.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2.text: You want to take him back West, to answer for his crimes there.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2.text: But I must take him East, to answer for his crimes against us. This constitutes a problem.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2.name: warrior
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2.text: First, we catch him. Then we can have a problem.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2_end.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2_end.text: ... as evidenced by the seeds being smaller than those of a common apple.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2_end.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2_end.text: If they are not, transmutation of this plant may only be performed in a private setting.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2_end.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_2_end.text: I have an eye to make some changes, when I ascend to the Circle of Elders.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.text: Thus we protect the secret. If the public thinks transmutation is an inborn ability --

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.text: if there is no technique -- then none will try to steal the secrets of the technique.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.name: warrior
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.text: But Reynard somehow came to know this? And learned the trick.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.text: 'Trick' is reductive. It's impressive that a stranger such as he

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.text: could learn the method. It's complex and nuanced, and normally requires years of training.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.text: But, yes. And the more he does it, so publicly, the more evidence that the story around transmutation is not what we've been telling.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.text: So the story may not last. But I don't personally mind that; I've no love for the falsehoods.

heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.name: druid
heroes3_warrior_and_druid_transmutation.text: I have an eye to make some changes, when I ascend to the Circle of Elders.

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_1.name: druid
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_1.text: It isn't magic of the kind you deal in.

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_1.name: druid
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_1.text: Aeons ago, before living beings arose to crawl the canyons and the steppes,

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_1.name: druid
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_1.text: the world was a simpler place. Rocky and pristine.

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_1.name: druid
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_1.text: The world slowly, slowly changed, from a pile of rocks, to this teeming green mass we are today.

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_2.name: druid
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_2.text: But all forms contain their seeds within.

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_2.name: druid
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_2.text: Our bodies still hold, in every mote of flesh, the full course of our slow transformation from lithic quietude to animal messiness.

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_2.name: druid
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_2.text: To be transmuted is a sort of ... descent through corporeal memory.

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_optional.name: wizard
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_optional.text: For ten years I was obsessed with the questions:

heroes3_wizard_and_druid_optional.name: wizard
heroes3_wizard_and_druid_optional.text: How do we teleport something bigger than a ... a quince? And can we make it happen faster?

heroes3_druid_and_priestess_1.name: druid
heroes3_druid_and_priestess_1.text: We have legends of her kind. Never sure what to believe.

heroes3_druid_and_priestess_1.name: druid
heroes3_druid_and_priestess_1.text: I'll say only that I am uneasy.

heroes3_druid_and_priestess_2.name: warrior
heroes3_druid_and_priestess_2.text: She's been with us a while. We wouldn't have gotten this far without her.

heroes3_four_with_button_quad.name: druid
heroes3_four_with_button_quad.text: If Golden Girl were here, I could freeze that Goblin and we'd be done.

heroes3_four_with_button_quad.name: warrior
heroes3_four_with_button_quad.text: I thought you were wary of her!

heroes3_four_with_button_quad.name: druid
heroes3_four_with_button_quad.text: I'm warming up to her. She's been a consistent ... godsend. Quite pretty as well.

heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.name: bard
heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.text: So, this Magistrate fellow... if he's so powerful, and now he's far from the reach of your King, ... why is he running from us?

heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.name: bard
heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.text: We are a formidable group ... but ...

heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.name: druid
heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.text: I don't believe he's fleeing, exactly.

heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.name: druid
heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.text: He's going *toward* something, rather than away. Earlier, he mentioned a specific destination.

heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.name: druid
heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.text: A 'special transport', beyond which his son was not to follow.

heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.name: thief
heroes3_bard_wizard_druid_pondering.text: He's taken two 'special transports' already! But you're right; this one seemed more ... final.

heroes3_six.name: thief
heroes3_six.text: Hey! Finally we're all together, at once!

heroes3_six.name: warrior
heroes3_six.text: If we keep pushing forward, we'll get out of this, like always.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: warrior
heroes3_victory_lap.text: The land beyond that color fringe looks ... vast.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: wizard
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Strange and ... disorienting!

heroes3_victory_lap.name: bard
heroes3_victory_lap.text: What dangers might that territory hold?

heroes3_victory_lap.name: thief
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Could we become lost out there, and never get back?

heroes3_victory_lap.name: druid
heroes3_victory_lap.text: It is my charge to apprehend that man. I will proceed regardless of what waits beyond.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: In that case, let me tell you all a story.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Once-a-time, just some months ago actually, the sickly moon casting down

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: through my window, I was knelt by my bed, praying.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Utterly despondent from all my problems. What do I do with my son Ratleigh,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: to help him become -- aught but such a useless lump?

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: And as for me -- is my time of youthful creativity expended?

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Am I to be set aside, my role from now til the End being merely to dodder and wither away?

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: I am an accomplished man. I have done some quite good things -- greatly increased the efficiency of the prisons,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: and ensured that many criminals could no longer feed upon the upright citizenry,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: and thus kept our land a healthy place in which the good may thrive.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: But such accomplishments, after years, become ... taken for granted. Usual, Obvious, Boring!

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Life had become paperwork, maintenance, a slate of ongoing convictions that really *anyone* could prosecute in my stead.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: I was weighed down each day with an ever-greater fatigue.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: On the night in question, I felt my usefulness had been fully exhausted. In complete honesty, I was drenched in tears.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: I was praying out loud, as I usually do -- so that God sees I really mean it, you know --

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: and for once, my prayers were heard in concrete fashion.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Before me appeared a woman, bathed in multicolored light, beatific.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: I understand now that she was not an angel, but she might as well have been.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: She said she needed my help.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: She had pledged her life to walking in the ways of God, and said that I could walk beside her,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: so long as I first did ... a certain thing.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: What she asked of me was very difficult to eventuate, and took lavish expenditure, I must say.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: She needed me to bring together a particular set of elements, all into one place:

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_warrior Warrior,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_thief Thief,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_wizard Wizard,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_priestess Priestess,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_bard Bard,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_druid Druid;

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_goblins Goblins,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_dragons Fire-breathing Dragons,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_crystals Crystals,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + flash_buttons_and_gates Buttons and Energy Gates;

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: and if I did all this, and did it well, she'd set me upon the course of a new life.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: She said I had truly exceptional powers of Judgement;

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: To be seen so clearly released in me a torrent of love.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: I have worked so hard to hone my Judgement, you have no idea how hard.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: She said she'd give me a new way to sophisticate my Judgement, in and among a wider Existence.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Dear Listener, she showed me visions,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: a vast array of distant lands, and I loved the whole of what I saw.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: I knelt to her, and pledged to perform.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: And now, *right* now, right this *second*,

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: the act is consummated.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: You won't catch me today. Perhaps not ever.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: But you haven't failed, because now we're all a part of something bigger.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: magistrate
heroes3_victory_lap.text: + magistrate_disappear 4.8 I *now* ... ... ... take my leave. See you later, Alligators!

heroes3_victory_lap.name: bard
heroes3_victory_lap.text: I think he's gone.

heroes3_victory_lap.name: thief
heroes3_victory_lap.text: He called us ... Alligators? What's an Alligator?

heroes3_victory_lap.name: wizard
heroes3_victory_lap.text: Sounds like some kind of monster!

heroes3_victory_lap.name: druid
heroes3_victory_lap.text: He's saying that actually *we're* the monsters?

heroes3_victory_lap.name: bard
heroes3_victory_lap.text: The very nerve!

heroes3_victory_lap_end.name: druid
heroes3_victory_lap_end.text: He hoped his tale of woe would move us. No. He flees, we follow, and apprehend. Simple.

heroes3_victory_lap_end.name: warrior
heroes3_victory_lap_end.text: I want my freedom back, and he's the key to it.

heroes3_victory_lap_end.name: wizard
heroes3_victory_lap_end.text: Seems like he's gone somewhere very strange.

heroes3_victory_lap_end.name: druid
heroes3_victory_lap_end.text: Then we're also going somewhere very strange.

heroes3_victory_lap_end.name: bard
heroes3_victory_lap_end.text: There is a great song to be written about whatever comes next.

heroes3_victory_lap_end.name: thief
heroes3_victory_lap_end.text: But will it be a paean or a dirge?

heroes3_victory_lap_end.name: warrior
heroes3_victory_lap_end.text: Depends how well we do, I guess.

promesst1_start.name: gemsman
promesst1_start.text: Suit, don't fall apart on me down here.

promesst1_lovely.name: gemsman
promesst1_lovely.text: The shifter's working! Might really get somewhere.

promesst1_cart.name: gemsman
promesst1_cart.text: Still grinding away! They really knew how to build stuff back then.

promesst1_wrap.name: gemsman
promesst1_wrap.text: Next question: how deep does this go?

promesst1_destroy_rover.name: gemsman
promesst1_destroy_rover.text: Justified. We'll learn to build new ones.

promesst1_egg.name: gemsman
promesst1_egg.text: Mottled, polished ... iridescent? But ... what is it?

promesst1_egg.name: gemsman
promesst1_egg.text: Does this have something to do with the Great Shutdown?

promesst1_exiting_egg_room.name: baby_dragon
promesst1_exiting_egg_room.text: Return with gems. Gems bring life!

promesst1_exiting_egg_room.name: gemsman
promesst1_exiting_egg_room.text: Uhh. The depths are getting to me.

promesst1_wand_get.name: gemsman
promesst1_wand_get.text: A rod of alabaster, fixed onto a leather cuff.

promesst1_wand_get.name: gemsman
promesst1_wand_get.text: Metallic fittings look to impart some function.

promesst2_torc_get.name: gemsman
promesst2_torc_get.text: A lucite torc, to be worn about the neck.

promesst3_prism_get.name: gemsman
promesst3_prism_get.text: A triangular prism on a chain, worn as a pendant.

promesst1_gemsuit_cannot_turn_1.name: gemsman
promesst1_gemsuit_cannot_turn_1.text: The gemsuit's too bulky; can't turn without space.

promesst1_gemsuit_cannot_turn_5.name: gemsman
promesst1_gemsuit_cannot_turn_5.text: Suit, you bless me, and you curse me.

promesst1_all_gems.name: gemsman
promesst1_all_gems.text: That's the last one. Now to tidy up.

promesst1_wand_strong.name: gemsman
promesst1_wand_strong.text: This thing is so powerful. Why'd they bury it?

promesst1_unlock.name: gemsman
promesst1_unlock.text: I feel something important just happened, but ... no idea what.

promesst2_start.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_start.text: Get the gems. Get them all.

promesst2_feed_gems.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_feed_gems.text: Give gems to me now. More gems deeper.

promesst2_feed_gems.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_feed_gems.text: Many more. Priceless. You get those. I get these.

promesst2_baby_dragon_very_hungry.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_baby_dragon_very_hungry.text: Very hungry now. Give me all. All.

promesst2_baby_will_eat_a.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_baby_will_eat_a.text: Feed me now! Just a few.

promesst2_baby_will_eat_b.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_baby_will_eat_b.text: Feed me gems. Gems give life!

promesst2_baby_will_eat_c.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_baby_will_eat_c.text: Hungry. Hungry! Give food. Give food.

promesst2_baby_impatient_b.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_baby_impatient_b.text: Get more gems. Get more foods!

promesst2_buildings.name: gemsman
promesst2_buildings.text: The amount of architecture is increasing as we go *down*...

promesst2_buildings.name: gemsman
promesst2_buildings.text: The tomes said buildings were *rare* in pocket mines, and near the surface.

promesst2_enjoying_torc.name: gemsman
promesst2_enjoying_torc.text: Wish I'd had this thing earlier.

promesst2_keep_some_a.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_keep_some_a.text: So hungry, but I will not eat.

promesst2_keep_some_b.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_keep_some_b.text: All the foods we must have.

promesst2_keep_some_b.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_keep_some_b.text: To get them, foods you need.

promesst2_keep_some_c.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_keep_some_c.text: Finding fresh foods. So very good.

promesst2_keep_some_c.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_keep_some_c.text: But also I must wait. Temper hunger.

promesst2_keep_some_d.name: baby_dragon
promesst2_keep_some_d.text: Tempting me. I can hardly stand it! But keep 9. Just a little longer.

promesst3_start.name: dragon
promesst3_start.text: Such a wonder, that your people and ours overlap in spaces such as this.

promesst3_start.name: dragon
promesst3_start.text: You open mines, we extrude nidi. Sometimes these turn out to have been the same.

promesst3_start.name: dragon
promesst3_start.text: + instant_duration 2.65 Our light crosses your light.

promesst3_start.name: dragon
promesst3_start.text: Your people used to know this!

promesst3_second_room.name: dragon
promesst3_second_room.text: I can hear the others, far away and faint.

promesst3_second_room.name: dragon
promesst3_second_room.text: They thank you for hatching me and helping me grow.

promesst3_second_room.name: gemsman
promesst3_second_room.text: I ... it was ... I was just going forward?

promesst3_second_room.name: dragon
promesst3_second_room.text: We'll get you more gems. Don't worry.

promesst3_gems_amount_1.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_1.text: I've no more use for these gems. Take all you want.

promesst3_gems_amount_2.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_2.text: To think I so recently hungered for these chunks of mere matter.

promesst3_gems_amount_3.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_3.text: Where oh where do you think your ancestors learned to make these artificial beam producers?

promesst3_gems_amount_3.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_3.text: Hmph. At least my people have hygiene.

promesst3_gems_amount_3.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_3.text: We don't throw our beams just everywhere.

promesst3_gems_amount_4.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_4.text: We lost all contact with your people some time back --

promesst3_gems_amount_4.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_4.text: Several lifetimes of one such as yourself.

promesst3_gems_amount_4.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_4.text: Our people do not maintain a grudge about those times.

promesst3_gems_amount_5.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_5.text: My role will be to seek more places where our volumes can superpose. Strengthen and enlarge.

promesst3_gems_amount_6.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_6.text: Light. Your people think they know some things about light and the casting of beams.

promesst3_gems_amount_6.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_6.text: And perhaps they do know a little. But to them I will bring *new* light.

promesst3_gems_amount_7.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_7.text: Our plan was for me to return with you, an emissary.

promesst3_gems_amount_7.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_7.text: But then, a deal was struck. Lavish expenditure.

promesst3_gems_amount_7.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_7.text: You will not return directly home, not yet.

promesst3_gems_amount_7.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_7.text: We will get you where you need to go next.

promesst3_gems_amount_8.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_8.text: You have done a good job here.

promesst3_gems_amount_8.name: dragon
promesst3_gems_amount_8.text: One final task, and you won't need me any more.

promesst3_took_time_a.name: dragon
promesst3_took_time_a.text: I know you want to use me, out here.

promesst3_took_time_b.name: gemsman
promesst3_took_time_b.text: I just ... it was a lot.

promesst3_gold_room.name: gemsman
promesst3_gold_room.text: That's done, now. Whatever it was.

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: Moments after I came through, the doorstead abruptly closed and disappeared. I am on my own for the time being.

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: I trust you'll reopen it when you can manage. Meanwhile, I shall look about.

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: I'll leave a trail of beacons, should you send someone after,

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: and set down what information I can, in case of my disappearance or expiry.

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: I'm standing in ... an anteroom. The furnishings are very strange, unlike the handiwork of any people known to me, historic or modern.

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: It does appear to be a completely other world.

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: These chambers were made for a large gathering, but they're empty.

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: The surfaces look newly made; no trace of wear, and no dust.

intro_1.name: sokoban
intro_1.text: Someone tends this place, so I should see him before long.

intro_before_teleporter.name: sokoban
intro_before_teleporter.text: There are plaques inscribed in an unknown language, glyphs I've never seen before, but I just ... know what they mean.

intro_before_teleporter.name: sokoban
intro_before_teleporter.text: This ... facility ... was constructed to receive strangers,

intro_before_teleporter.name: sokoban
intro_before_teleporter.text: which explains the pronounced peak in the sounding-outs: they are advertising this place.

intro_before_teleporter.name: sokoban
intro_before_teleporter.text: There's something ahead ... I don't know where it leads.

intro_before_teleporter.name: sokoban
intro_before_teleporter.text: But of course I'm going through. Ever forward.

sokoban_overworld.name: sokoban
sokoban_overworld.text: I've explored a good deal of the surrounding territory.

sokoban_overworld.name: sokoban
sokoban_overworld.text: There is more here than I presently understand; you'll have to see for yourself.

sokoban_overworld.name: sokoban
sokoban_overworld.text: From here, North is the clearest way to make progress. Avoid the West until you are ready for sterner work.

sokoban_overworld.name: sokoban
sokoban_overworld.text: Quigley, we have indeed done it. Rest assured that I count my life's work a success, regardless of what may follow.

audiolog_g_possession.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_possession.text: Repetition has accustomed me somewhat, but it's still very strange.

audiolog_g_possession.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_possession.text: I feel as though I'm making the decisions ... but I'm sure they believe the decisions are theirs.

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: Extravagant. But it has me thinking: much in this place is not what it appears.

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: For whoever could construct so vast a place as this --

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: who could reproduce these buildings, objects, natural environs in such number and variety --

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: surely conjuring a little gold would be of no great difficulty.

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: Gold, then, could scarcely be precious, yet here it's displayed as though it were.

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: Still, I am impressed, and maybe that's it: to dazzle the uninitiated.

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: I've caught glimpses of several such platforms. Perhaps there is some order to their distribution.

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: But this is the first I have managed to stand upon, and I have yet to engage with its central star.

audiolog_g_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_gold_rooms.text: So I've no idea yet of the function of these golden platforms, but it's time I found out.

audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.text: This is the third gilded deck that I have found; I am starting to see the pattern,

audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.text: and I have some notion of the shape of the whole.

audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.text: It's striking -- Quigley, I see the layout as mathematical,

audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.text: but you might choose to see it as ceremonial,

audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_how_many_gold_rooms.text: each thing in its accorded place.

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: This place brings together elements from different worlds.

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: Those who built it would not build thousands more, I should think,

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: if they employed the same worlds each time. They'd merely be reproducing the same result.

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: This implies that there are many more worlds from which to draw than the four enclosed here.

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: Quigley, I expect we could find another facility, perhaps many, now that we know what to look for.

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: I wonder what worlds they hold -- what strange behaviors we might see, as with the water --

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: I haven't told you this yet. There is so much to set down.

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: Two of the worlds have water so dense it will drown you at the mere depth of a man;

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: In the others, water repels itself when agglomerated beyond a certain size, so you just get a profusion of large drops;

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: in those worlds there's no such thing as an expanse of water.

audiolog_g_world_selection_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_1.text: When we broaden our explorations, what else might we see?

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: Before they can employ a world to their mysterious ends, they must locate it somehow, and connect.

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: By what criteria do they locate? "I want a place wherein machinery casts beams of light, powered by giant gems --"

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: How would that even work? Or are the criteria specified in some other way that helps this make sense?

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: Quigley, unless you've made considerable discoveries in my absence,

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: by our way of doorsteading, it would be a random search --

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: we'd have to test our guesses exhaustively, exposing the traveler to unknown hazards each time.

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: Surely the tossing of the dice would bring misfortune sooner than later.

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: So their techniques must be of a different nature -- and vastly more effective.

audiolog_g_world_selection_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_2.text: If we could learn even a small bit about this, our progress would accelerate tremendously.

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: A curious thought has come to me, and I wonder if you would see it the same way.

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: These worlds are chosen according to the kinds of events that happen inside them. Keep that in mind for a moment.

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: Our doorstead, by which we sent me here, is of course very special and unique,

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: but we based it on the common technology already in use for a hundred years.

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: My observation is: none of the worlds into which I've ventured have even these mundane doorsteads.

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: Three of them have various kinds of remote transport abilities,

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: but they permit only the translocation of single, discrete objects.

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: None of them connect space itself, or provide the convenience and capacity of a doorstead.

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: To a visitor from one of these other places, the behavior of *our* world would seem peculiar,

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: the way we would consider those elephantine gems peculiar.

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: Earlier I asked how these Builders find their component worlds. I put it to you, Quigley: is it possible that my arrival here

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: was encouraged, as a means of their finding *us*? Will one of these stars find me back in our own world, faced with

audiolog_g_world_selection_3.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_world_selection_3.text: some carefully constructed enigma about maneuvering a doorstead through a doorstead?

audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.text: Quigley, this way of getting around is ... charming. I don't mind it.

audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.text: Of course I have always enjoyed the binary partitioning

audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.text: we use for National Transport (confusing though it may be to newcomers);

audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.text: but the weakness of our scheme is that it manifests as a sequence of skips, which create a linear path, like a road.

audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.text: Of course, we make a web of roads. But the underlying limitation into one dimension is still there.

audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.text: Here, travel is free across two dimensions.

audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.text: So. How do these transportation platforms work? Could we build these in our world too,

audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_fast_travel.text: or do they function due to some enabling property in the basic nature of this place, absent in ours?

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: Speaking of which, another question is naturally raised: Where does this place exist, wherein I now stand?

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: I don't mean just this miniaturized version of the facility, but, really, the whole place.

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: Let's say we have a world A that has its particular laws of Nature, and another world B, which has its own, different, laws of Nature.

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: To create a place where people and objects from both A and B can interact,

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: well, it's clear the laws of Nature of A and B cannot be in direct conflict each withother.

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: But the space itself that contains this fusion -- what were its laws of Nature prior to the

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: introduction of A or B, when it was quiet and empty awaiting some contents to arrive?

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: The laws of Nature of such a place must have been compatible with both, perhaps a subset of A and B,

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: that can yet be built outward to meet A or B where necessary. Or else a superset of A and B,

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: How do you make such a substrate? Is there one substrate for all worlds,

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: or are there different substrates that manifest as needed?

audiolog_g_substrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_substrate.text: I shall try to apprehend more.

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: It obviously requires a great deal of work and care to arrange all this.

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: I face the challenges they've put before me,

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: and I don't do too badly, if I may say.

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: Is this a test? Do I earn distinction by passing?

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: Is it a kind of training, to make me more capable of solving problems?

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: Is it merely a show of grand workmanship, like the monuments of forgotten civilizations?

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: They left no direction as to my purpose here. Why not?

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: And lastly -- perhaps most importantly: Why is it unpopulated?

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: I'd have expected to see someone... ... a real person *here*, not in the worlds... well before now.

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: Why build all this, then abandon it?

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: I'll continue. Ever forward. What other course is given me?

audiolog_g_work_and_care.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_work_and_care.text: New facts may make sense of this yet.

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: I'm down to five beacons, not counting this one.

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: As I have ventured farther from the center in a few directions now,

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: I've seen that the stars -- the entries to other worlds -- they decrease in density.

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: I still don't know the full extent of their spread, but the thinning-out gives me hope of a reasonable, finite size.

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: Quigley, you're still not here. I hope all is well on your end.

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: I should expect to be in some alarm by now, for want of food and fresh water.

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: But here I don't seem to need nourishment. You know I love a good brisket,

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: but here the physical hunger just never arises. That's one more item to investigate.

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: Parsons always complains of the nuisance of eating.

audiolog_g_no_eating.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_no_eating.text: Send him through if you get a chance; he'll love it here.

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: By now I've been through many of these locked gates and cage-like fixtures...

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: and I see that these fixtures are not here to block me full stop.

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: They are here to block me *until*.

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: Until I know what they want me to know, and am thereby prepared for the next place, to confront the next problem.

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: Just as this whole territory is organized with each star occupying its proper place,

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: these silvery barriers are arranged quite intentionally, each invisibly joined to its star, each star holding an idea.

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: If I were to trace the constellations on a map, the connections from star to star, and star to cage,

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: they would make a delicate webwork.

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: An underlying geometry, compressed and occulted,

audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_musing_on_freezers_1.text: a chart of relations in that realm of Ideas that we humans can only dream of touching directly.

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: Quigley, It's been a long time.

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: I am not sure how long; I've no cycle of the sun by which to count,

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: and I've been gradually unburdening myself of devices.

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: I confess that home is beginning to feel distant, more like a half-remembered dream than a real place I might hope ever to inhabit once again.

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: Unceasingly alone, every day I feel closer to these worlds and their inhabitants. Even though I cannot speak to them.

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: And also, between the worlds... I'm starting to see, faintly,

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: certain kinds of connections. Silken strands.

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: Perhaps... Perhaps I don't *want* to return, except to see for a moment how you're all getting on.

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: Then I would be on my way again.

audiolog_g_far_from_home.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_far_from_home.text: I must keep driving forward. Ever onward. Ever forward.

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: Quigley, I'll continue to address you when I leave these recordings,

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: but I confess that it now feels a bit false.

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: I've realized that I'm not merely speaking to *you* any more.

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: As I navigate these trials, I feel I'm being judged by a watchful eye whose nature I know not.

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: I now realize this feeling has been pervasive from the beginning. Low and subtle.

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
