audiolog_g_being_watched.text: I find myself courting that Watcher's approval; I wish to be judged clever and perceptive,

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: and this shows itself in the topics I choose to discuss, and the precise words I employ.

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: Yet I see no evidence of a Watcher physically present. I wander alone.

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: Is He some spirit peering in from Beyond,

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: the way I observe the denizens of these... challenge worlds... from this higher place?

audiolog_g_being_watched.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_being_watched.text: Regardless. Prickles at the back of my neck, I feel that watchful eye.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: Quigley,

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: I am starting to think --

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: I was assuming you were doing your best to follow me with a rescue team.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: We made *careful* provision for this contingency and many others. Don't you remember?

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: But now I wonder. It has been a long time. With me gone, you are the head of the group,

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: the elite laboratory built around a world-altering invention.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: Leamington was rash, you'd say. He barreled through before we could properly ensure his safety.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: He is gone but will live nobly in our memories, while the fame and fortune go to us....

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: Perhaps there was no accident at all. Perhaps you shut the door with cold hands.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: Or perhaps you just cannot get back. For reasons I cannot presently conceive.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: I'm sure there are many difficulties. There are always many difficulties.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: I will try to prevent myself from assuming the worst, but I am done assuming the best either;

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: clinging to hopes that never materialize -- it is not helping me move forward.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: Goodbye, Quigley. From this point I assume that I shall never see you again.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: Whatever is to be gained here, it is for me to discover on my own.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: The team have all been great friends to me, even you, seemingly.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: But I built my life from nothing once already, and I may yet carve out another life here.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: For I've now seen signs of the caretakers of this Overworld.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: A shimmer through the haze -- a shadowy figure in the distance, cloaked -- gone before I could reach that spot.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: It has happened more than once. They are watching.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: The people who dreamt up all this. People who seem interested in *me*.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: They are just waiting for me to advance a few more steps.

audiolog_g_crisis.name: sokoban
audiolog_g_crisis.text: And I'm about to do so.

skipping_stones_start.name: boat
skipping_stones_start.text: Are you all right, fleshy one?

skipping_stones_start.name: sailor
skipping_stones_start.text: Banged my shoulder when you stopped so suddenly.

skipping_stones_start.name: sailor
skipping_stones_start.text: It's bruised, stiff, and annoying, like some people we know, but, nothing permanent.

skipping_stones_start.name: sailor
skipping_stones_start.text: And since my upper body took the impact, my legs feel *great*!

skipping_stones_start.name: boat
skipping_stones_start.text: Fortunate, as I cannot move at all. We'll need you to fetch that map over there.

skipping_stones_start.name: sailor
skipping_stones_start.text: Fetch? Shall I also scratch my fleas and bark at the parcelier?

skipping_stones_start.name: boat
skipping_stones_start.text: Do it how you do it, just get that map!

skipping_stones_start_repeat.name: boat
skipping_stones_start_repeat.text: This is a complex chain of islands; your first step is getting that map!

ssnew_pre_map.name: boat
ssnew_pre_map.text: The problem is coming from a spot south of here.

ssnew_pre_map.name: boat
ssnew_pre_map.text: On the map, you'll see the one area I could scry through the fog. Go there.

ssnew_interdiction_first.name: sailor
ssnew_interdiction_first.text: When we get back to civilization, this will make a great story!

ssnew_interdiction_first.name: sailor
ssnew_interdiction_first.text: Well... I did have a moment of panic when you just froze up! That counts for something.

ssnew_interdiction_first.name: boat
ssnew_interdiction_first.text: Miracle we weren't dashed to pieces.

ssnew_interdiction_first.name: sailor
ssnew_interdiction_first.text: 'Miracle' is going in my official report.

ssnew_traps.name: boat
ssnew_traps.text: I've been thinking... Look out for traps.

ssnew_traps.name: boat
ssnew_traps.text: Triplines, or spikejaws just beneath the sand? It's just ... very suspicious.

ssnew_traps.name: boat
ssnew_traps.text: If the Guild had placed an interdict on these islands, we'd have been told.

ssnew_traps.name: sailor
ssnew_traps.text: Then, we'll have to have a talk with them.

ssnew_what_do_i_do.name: sailor
ssnew_what_do_i_do.text: So, when I get to the South, what do I do?

ssnew_what_do_i_do.name: boat
ssnew_what_do_i_do.text: You'll see a bunch of writing on the ground. Carefully-arranged symbols. You just need to mess them up.

ssnew_what_do_i_do.name: boat
ssnew_what_do_i_do.text: I can't quite scry *how* the interdict is written, but if it's symbols laid in the sand,

ssnew_what_do_i_do.name: boat
ssnew_what_do_i_do.text: a good scuff will do. You just need to get there.

ssnew_no_traps.name: sailor
ssnew_no_traps.text: No traps, and no strangers. We're alone.

ssnew_no_traps.name: sailor
ssnew_no_traps.text: But I feel you're still nervous. Is there something you're not telling me?

ssnew_no_traps.name: boat
ssnew_no_traps.text: Wellll... There are... features... of these islands...

ssnew_no_traps.name: boat
ssnew_no_traps.text: I'll brief you when the time comes. For now let's stay focused.

ssnew_no_traps.name: sailor
ssnew_no_traps.text: Oh come on. Just give me a hint.

ssnew_no_traps.name: boat
ssnew_no_traps.text: I'll give you two: Gold, and Conflux.

ssnew_no_traps.name: sailor
ssnew_no_traps.text: 'Gold and Conflux'. Dockside palm-readers give more for a copper.

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: So, an interdict is just writing?

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: boat
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: I can't believe you don't know!

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: They don't teach us Boat secrets, okay! Sailor school is mostly knots.

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: boat
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: Then learn: an interdict is essentially just a sign, written on a wall or on the ground.

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: boat
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: If you can copy the writing, you can lay interdicts of your own...

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: boat
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: so the Guild hides the writing. Locked in dark vaults, opened only on true emergency:

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: boat
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: theft of a critical Boat, or an insurrection needs quelling. You know ... business.

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: So why, no, *how* are we being interdicted *here*? In a place that's just a smudge on the charts?

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: The nearest outpost is a week away.

ssnew_interdictions_secret.name: boat
ssnew_interdictions_secret.text: That is the question I'd like you to go kick.

ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.text: Let's tally the day so far. First insult: you called me "fleshy one,"

ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.text: Two, you sent me to fetch. Three, refused to tell me

ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.text: what I'm blindly strolling into, that for all I know could kill me;

ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.text: Four, belittled me for not knowing *secrets* that are, as you know, *kept secret* exactly so Sailors like myself don't know them!

ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.name: boat
ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.text: Well, I dislike your counting. Five offenses!

ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.name: sailor
ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.text: You can't tally during the tally!

ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.name: boat
ssnew_interdictions_secret_2.text: I'm a bonded carrier of the Guild. I can always tally.

ssnew_heading_west.name: sailor
ssnew_heading_west.text: Looks like the islands run West for a while.

ssnew_heading_west.name: boat
ssnew_heading_west.text: Does it get you closer to where you want to go?

ssnew_heading_west.name: boat
ssnew_heading_west.text: I'm pretty old. From a distance they look the same.

ssnew_weather.name: boat
ssnew_weather.text: I'm feeling a change in the winds, far to the south.

ssnew_weather.name: boat
ssnew_weather.text: They're getting faster and rougher. Nothing I'd worry about yet,

ssnew_weather.name: boat
ssnew_weather.text: but we might face trouble later on.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: sailor
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: Calling me "skipper" now? Thank you for the joke that is clearly very funny.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: boat
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: You're coming up on one of those things I haven't yet told you about.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: boat
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: There's a strange structure embedded in the next island over. A big golden platform.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: boat
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: It appears bright on my scry, beacon-like. Someone wants us to go there.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: sailor
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: Maybe that's one of your traps...

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: boat
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: I wish you knew what a scry looked like *internally*, in the mind, so I could describe an important thing here:

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: boat
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: There are tendrils of energy that should connect to somewhere here. But they don't. They go off... as if toward another world.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: boat
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: I've never seen its like before.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: sailor
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: This is incredible, actually! All we have to do is tell them where it is; The guild can send a team to figure it out.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: sailor
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: They'll pay us a fabulous bonus, and we'll be legends!

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: boat
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: Maybe so. We'll have to get out of here first.

skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.name: boat
skipping_stones_gold_room_impending.text: Just be sure to visit that ... shrine? ... when you get there.

skipping_stones_shrine.name: sailor
skipping_stones_shrine.text: I touched the center, and ... lights bloomed all around me. Then, nothing.

skipping_stones_shrine.name: boat
skipping_stones_shrine.text: I felt it from here. A great pulse went out, toward some other place.

skipping_stones_shrine.name: boat
skipping_stones_shrine.text: A message, perhaps. A short one. What it said? No idea.

skipping_stones_shrine.name: boat
skipping_stones_shrine.text: I think you just keep going.

ssnew_tacking.name: sailor
ssnew_tacking.text: You know how happy I am to follow your instructions.

ssnew_tacking.name: sailor
ssnew_tacking.text: You said go West, so I kept going West... but now, you know, I think we've overshot.

ssnew_tacking.name: boat
ssnew_tacking.text: The Winds of Fate are attempting to blow us away from our goal.

ssnew_tacking.name: boat
ssnew_tacking.text: But, weaving to and fro, we'll get there.

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: It's time for me to bother you again, about *two* things this time.

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: First: that green island there is your target.

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: + fog_clear 'whirlpool 0.1 That circle is the interdict, right there!

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: Symbols drawn on rocks, placed in the grass.

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: Get there, kick a rock aside. Simple in theory.

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: The river doesn't skirt that isle; you'll have to keep tacking and come from the other side.

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: Which brings us to our *second* point. If you check your map...

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: you'll find this river feeds directly into the biggest mouth you've ever seen. Gigantic whirlpool!

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: sailor
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: Biggest mouth that *I've* ever seen? You've seen bigger?

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: boat
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: If you are swallowed, there will be no way home for me. Think of me, please.

skipping_stones_whirlpool.name: sailor
skipping_stones_whirlpool.text: Thanks, boat. I'll figure something out.

ssnew_built_in_1.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_1.text: So *that's* the grinding sound I hear.

ssnew_built_in_1.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_1.text: *I've been thinking*, how does some writing on the ground actually hold *you* locked down, from so far away?

ssnew_built_in_1.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_1.text: My shoulder will attest that the effect was not gentle.

ssnew_built_in_1.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_1.text: But you're saying some small-ish rocks on a beach did this. How could that possibly work?

ssnew_built_in_1.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_1.text: You're right. It doesn’t work that way. The boat stops itself.

ssnew_built_in_1.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_1.text: The ship, that I'm currently using as my body, refuses to obey me. It's built into the bones.

ssnew_built_in_2.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_2.text: As you know, the way my runners pull us forward at such tremendous speeds --

ssnew_built_in_2.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_2.text: -- fashioned from the skipping stones, I know --

ssnew_built_in_2.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_2.text: -- and you turn them to various angles --

ssnew_built_in_2.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_2.text: Yes, but I don’t move the runners directly. My force of will, such as it is, is insufficient for that --

ssnew_built_in_2.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_2.text: Compared to yourself, a thimble per a dram.

ssnew_built_in_2.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_2.text: My will acts on control struts made of a special *different* stone

ssnew_built_in_2.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_2.text: that is quite sensitive and pliant...

ssnew_built_in_2.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_2.text: Ahh yeah, with the cables and bushings. I had to clean those, that one time.

ssnew_built_in_2.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_2.text: Those struts have embedded scriers that constantly watch for interdiction marks;

ssnew_built_in_2.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_2.text: One glimpse and the control struts lock rigid.

ssnew_built_in_3.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_3.text: So these famous interdictions, that *feel* like super-powerful magic, are just self-sabotage.

ssnew_built_in_3.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_3.text: No enemy would self-sabotage. So actually, this would be useless in a battle?

ssnew_built_in_3.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_3.text: But the public perception is that the interdiction is a combat weapon.

ssnew_built_in_3.name: sailor
ssnew_built_in_3.text: Wait. Are you allowed to tell *me* this?

ssnew_built_in_3.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_3.text: If we die here, then it didn't matter, eh. As for the public, it's a boring rumor.

ssnew_built_in_3.name: boat
ssnew_built_in_3.text: False tales of interdictions stopping an invasion fleet cold in the water -- now those are exciting!

ssnew_please_disable_interdict.name: sailor
ssnew_please_disable_interdict.text: If I'm not fast enough for you, you can find someone else!

ssnew_please_disable_interdict.name: boat
ssnew_please_disable_interdict.text: Have to set sail with the crew you have, as they once said.

ssnew_please_disable_interdict.name: boat
ssnew_please_disable_interdict.text: Now do the deed and let's get going... quickly.

ssnew_please_disable_interdict.name: sailor
ssnew_please_disable_interdict.text: 'Quickly'? I don't like the way you said that. What's going on?

skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.text: So, let me chart this out. You went right by the island with the interdict,

skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.text: but you didn't disarm it? What kind of a joke is this?

skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.name: sailor
skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.text: I'm not sure what happened... I don't ... hmm.

skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.text: Now that you've displaced all these stones and lilies,

skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.text: I don't think it's possible for you to get back there again. If only there were some way to change the past.

skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.name: sailor
skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.text: Why are you saying that, in such a suggestive way?

skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_no_impeller.text: Dear, I'm from the spirit world. I know some things.

skipping_stones_approaching_impeller.name: boat
skipping_stones_approaching_impeller.text: There it is just north of you. A miniature paradise, but tarry not.

skipping_stones_approaching_impeller.name: boat
skipping_stones_approaching_impeller.text: Besmirch those symbols, break the interdiction!

ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_0.name: boat
ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_0.text: Get back before the storm wipes us out!

ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.name: boat
ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.text: Get back before the storm wipes us out!

ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.name: sailor
ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.text: Can you tell who did this?

ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.name: boat
ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.text: I see nothing helpful. Maybe this is just about protecting treasure.

ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.name: sailor
ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.text: Right! Freeze up anyone who wants to scoot around and dig.

ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.name: sailor
ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.text: *Can* we scoot around and dig, now?

ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.name: boat
ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.text: No. There's a residual effect. I can now sail away from these isles,

ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.name: boat
ssnew_interdict_destroyed_treasures_n.text: but were I to go further in, I'd get stuck again. We'd be hurricane food.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: A buried treasure! How did I not -- Ahh. Yes, it was a special insulating chest that occults from scry.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: Heard of those before, never seen one. What's inside?

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: Rolled up parchment. Unrolling, it's completely blank.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: But here's the thing: it's perfect. There are no crinkles or rips.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: Grains of sand just slide off. So do droplets of water, and the paper remains dry.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: I've never heard of such a thing, outside fantasy stories.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: Nor I. This is an incredible find.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: This disaster we're in has yielded a boon. Just like your tales of old.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: Consider this: we Sailors are trained not to put all our eggs and so forth.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: We've found *one* chest. To me, that's a clue that there may be more. Can you see anything?

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: Now that I have this example to work from, ... yes. All occulted, so I can't see where,

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: but when the boxes hide the space inside, it makes little bumps in the aether, which I can feel.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: There are six treasures in total and now you have one.

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: Six! If they're all as nice as this one, we'll be made sector supervisors when we get back!

skipping_stones_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_1.text: Maybe so. To get them all, you'd have to be quite shrewd.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: I've found a second treasure! This looks like a ruler for measuring distance on charts.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: The markings are of fine platinum; the units of measurement are smaller than our inches.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: In place of the numbers are strange symbols, one solitary symbol where each number would be.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: I guess these *are* the numbers? But no multiple digits.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: The body of the ruler looks like dark wood. But the strangest thing is ...

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: it's stretchy along its length, as if it were made of rubber.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: But only when I pull it lengthwise. When I try to bend it, it's rigid.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: When I stretch it, the length markings all become further apart, uniformly.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: And all the while, it just looks and feels like natural wood.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: Wood that stretches? For a boat, the stuff of nightmares.

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: Rulers are for measuring. So why would you want the measurement lines to stretch?

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: Let's not get too distracted. If we don't get out of here,

skipping_stones_treasures_2.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_2.text: these treasures may be our only companions for quite a long time. I doubt they're entertaining to converse with.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: I've got another treasure. This is a bag of pins, also platinum.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: Engraved on the head of each pin, and then painted, are a variety of scenes:

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: cities, deserts, ocean cliffs ... there may be a hundred such pins. Each image is different.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: Not immediately. Hmm. Strange. The pins stay aligned in the bag.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: They don't feel magnetic, but any time two of them come close, they just happen to line up neatly. But with no force I can detect.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: It's effortless to turn them away from each other, but they just prefer to turn back.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: The engravings are unworn; the colors and edges are perfect.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: I'm glad you thought to look for other chests.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: So far, all these treasures seem to be implements for charting.

skipping_stones_treasures_3.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_3.text: Pieces of the same set. Maybe we'll find more, to help this make sense.

skipping_stones_treasures_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_4.text: This one's strange. It's like a portable sundial, with engravings around the circumference and a post in the middle.

skipping_stones_treasures_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_4.text: As I turn it, the shadow from the post lands in places I don't expect.

skipping_stones_treasures_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_4.text: It doesn't match the natural shadows from my hands.

skipping_stones_treasures_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_4.text: I don't understand how this is possible.

skipping_stones_treasures_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_4.text: normally if we find one such in an entire season, we'd be lucky.

skipping_stones_treasures_5.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_5.text: This one is a bottle of ink, but there's no cap. Just an open-mouthed bottle.

skipping_stones_treasures_5.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_5.text: When I opened the chest, it was lying on its side, but no ink had spilled out.

skipping_stones_treasures_5.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_5.text: At first I thought the ink was all dried up, but as I wave the bottle, it sloshes around inside, just as you'd expect.

skipping_stones_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_5.text: But the ink just refuses to go out the mouth, for no reason you can see?

skipping_stones_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_5.text: Were I a being with hands — especially clumsy hands like yours —

skipping_stones_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_5.text: I'd think quite well of ink that cannot spill.

skipping_stones_treasures_5.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_5.text: Indeed. With this, we've got five treasures now, so we're basically 99 percent done.

skipping_stones_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_5.text: You can think of it that way, if you want.

skipping_stones_treasures_6.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_6.text: This one looks like a fountain pen. There's a dial around neck of the pen, and as I turn it, the tip ... changes shape!

skipping_stones_treasures_6.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_6.text: Fine point... thick point... a short-whiskered brush... a blotter... a ball scored with a spiral groove.

skipping_stones_treasures_6.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_6.text: Don't play with it too much! Let's not break it!

skipping_stones_treasures_6.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_6.text: Sorry! It just feels good to hold... And manipulate!

skipping_stones_treasures_6.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_6.text: Hands. Must be nice. Anyway, that's the last of the treasures. I detect nothing more.

skipping_stones_treasures_6.name: sailor
skipping_stones_treasures_6.text: You see! It was worth the excursion!

skipping_stones_treasures_6.name: boat
skipping_stones_treasures_6.text: Now, please get back here *very* quickly.

skipping_stones_return_treasures_0.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_treasures_0.text: Welcome back! Let's get out of here.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.text: + victory Thank Goodness, we get to leave. I won't be compelled to abandon this body here, after all.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.text: Let us set forth. It's a long distance back to the outpost.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.text: The route is circuitous, and we'll be passing through some unknown places on the way.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.text: Do you think we'll have smooth sailing all the way back, or shall we be waylaid again?

skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.text: If I were a betting djinn, which you *know* I am, I'd put a few silvers on 'waylaid'.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_0.text: Off into the next calamity, then. Seaward heyo!

skipping_stones_return_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_treasures_1.text: Good to see you again. Let us go.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.text: + victory Hey. Treasures! You said there were six. Let's get the rest.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.text: No time. I've scried an incoming storm of incredible power. We'll be wrecked if we don't leave now.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.text: Fine. We'll wait out the storm, then come back and get the rest!

skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.text: If the storm doesn't feed them to the sea.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.text: That box you found was peeking out of the sand a bit, yeah?

skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.text: Hmm, ... yes! No decent sailor would bury a strongbox less than three feet under. Double that, if he's actually serious.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.text: It's possible that storms have been gradually unearthing them. This one may finish the job. We'll see.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_1.text: First we get away. You can adore your new treasure as we go, and rejoice that we're alive.

skipping_stones_return_treasures_2_to_4.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_treasures_2_to_4.text: Perfect. Let's get out of this place.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: + victory We haven't got all the treasures. But the rest should be easy now!

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: We'll just quickly hop to any islands I missed, and dig a bit.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: In a gentler world, yes. But the storm bearing down on us is truly fearsome.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: We're not certain to escape its wrath even if we leave immediately.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: Okay. Once the weather's clear, -- and we get a bit of a rest! -- we'll come back for the other treasures.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: If the storm doesn't feed them to the sea.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: Those you found were peeking out of the sand a bit, yeah?

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: So right! Any decent Sailor would bury these *nicely* deep.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: It's possible that storms have been gradually unearthing them. This one may finish the job.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: But for now it doesn't matter. When we're clear and cruising, you can dote on your treasures.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_2_to_4.text: We'll get some rest, and see if it makes sense to return. In the meantime...

skipping_stones_return_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_treasures_5.text: Great to see you, but we have to go, NOW.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.text: + victory Why do you want to go? The sun is warm, the sky is calm.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.text: The sky is going to change very quickly.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.text: I scry a storm of incredible size, moving rapidly, directly to these islands.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.text: Even if we leave immediately, we'll take some of it. My job now is to minimize that.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.text: I'm annoyed we didn't get that final treasure, but, let's go. Five treasures is a lot.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_5.text: Five treasures is a lot. Homeward heyo!

skipping_stones_return_treasures_all.name: sailor
skipping_stones_return_treasures_all.text: I'm back, and I have it all!

skipping_stones_return_treasures_all.name: boat
skipping_stones_return_treasures_all.text: We may yet pay the cost of your indiscretion. But let's get out of here, quickly.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.text: Storm's still coming. We're bound to take some of it. Let's minimize that.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.text: I'm proud of us! Faced with disaster, did we settle for mere survival? No!

skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.name: sailor
skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.text: We settled for *rich*! And a step up within the Guild, I'd predict.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.text: We're coming away with a great bounty. I'm glad I chose you as a partner.

skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.name: boat
skipping_stones_done_treasures_all.text: Keep telling yourself that. While we set out.

skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.name: boat
skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.text: Hey! Just where are you going?

skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.text: This island over here looks interesting. And suspicious.

skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.text: Don't think of it as greed. Think of it as ... adventureness.

skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.text: These treasures represent not just our future wealth. Not just our future *status*. (Think of the status!)

skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.text: But also, they're remnants of an unknown people, a precious material record of some lost part of the world!

skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.text: You don't want the precious knowledge contained within these treasures to be lost, do you?

skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.name: boat
skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.text: I don't want the precious knowledge contained within *us* to be lost.

skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_yes_treasure.text: I'll be back soon! Don't *go* anywhere.

skipping_stones_island_west_no_treasures.name: boat
skipping_stones_island_west_no_treasures.text: Hey! Just where are you going?

skipping_stones_island_west_no_treasures.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_no_treasures.text: This island over here looks interesting. I don't know.

skipping_stones_island_west_no_treasures.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_no_treasures.text: I want to see what's over this way. If we leave now, we'll never know.

skipping_stones_island_west_no_treasures.name: sailor
skipping_stones_island_west_no_treasures.text: My terrible priorities are the very reason the Guild employs me!

pals_start.name: sailor_alt
pals_start.text: Thank you for answering my call!

pals_start.name: boat
pals_start.text: If you'll check the map, I've located her Boat.

pals_start.name: boat
pals_start.text: Look for the clearing in the fog to the East.

pals_get_going.name: boat
pals_get_going.text: Best get going! Those interdicts are stubborn and will not break themselves.

pals_two.name: boat
pals_two.text: + fog_clear 'interdicts 0.01 There are *two* interdicts this time. You'll have to hit them both.

pals_two.name: boat
pals_two.text: I've spotted them on your map.

pals_job_1.name: sailor
pals_job_1.text: So, what do you do ... when you're not being ... locked down, I mean?

pals_job_1.name: sailor_alt
pals_job_1.text: Oh, I find new territories and survey them --

pals_job_1.name: sailor_alt
pals_job_1.text: so Jackashores like you can face the danger and make the fame, I suppose.

pals_job_2.name: sailor
pals_job_2.text: You're doing well on land, so far! You never wanted to be a Sailor?

pals_job_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_job_2.text: Surveying suits me. I don't have to deal with anyone too important.

pals_job_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_job_2.text: I'm not good at making friends, so. There is that too.

pals_job_3.name: sailor_alt
pals_job_3.text: Also since I never haul valuables, there is no incentive to be attacked.

pals_job_3.name: sailor
pals_job_3.text: *We* don't get attacked! Not too often... there was that one time.

pals_job_4.name: sailor_alt
pals_job_4.text: I understand the colloquialism, but where I come from, it is uncommon.

pals_where_from_1.name: sailor
pals_where_from_1.text: So where *do* you come from? I'm guessing by your hair --

pals_where_from_1.name: sailor_alt
pals_where_from_1.text: Yes, the Eastern Reaches, about as far as the Guild has ever mapped.

pals_where_from_1.name: sailor_alt
pals_where_from_1.text: Six months' journey if the weather be kind,

pals_where_from_1.name: sailor_alt
pals_where_from_1.text: even in a fast boat like mine. Or yours!

pals_where_from_2.name: sailor
pals_where_from_2.text: Eastern Reaches. How'd you get into the Guild, then?

pals_where_from_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_where_from_2.text: Met a fellow. Diplomat from your Mainland. It is not uncommon for a paramour to be given a job; working up to Surveyor took demonstration of real skills.

pals_where_from_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_where_from_2.text: He did all he could to put up with me, but he was relieved when I set out on my first voyage.

pals_where_from_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_where_from_2.text: Good guy. Haven't seen him since.

pals_deadwaters.name: sailor
pals_deadwaters.text: So... have you seen the Deadwaters?

pals_deadwaters.name: sailor_alt
pals_deadwaters.text: Young guys would go out there on dares, make games of the danger. Usually they all came back.

pals_deadwaters.name: sailor_alt
pals_deadwaters.text: But it is the times they do not that make the reputation.

pals_deadwaters.name: sailor_alt
pals_deadwaters.text: I went along once, watched from afar. The water shines like polished onyx, dead flat for as far as you can see.

pals_deadwaters.name: sailor_alt
pals_deadwaters.text: It stops stones dead in their tracks. They cannot skip. All that energy, just eaten.

pals_deadwaters.name: sailor
pals_deadwaters.text: Sounds beautiful. Like the glassy eye of a beast of the Distant Sea.

pals_deadwaters.name: sailor_alt
pals_deadwaters.text: It is frightening. I have never gone back.

pals_interdict_1.name: boat
pals_interdict_1.text: First interdict is broken. Good job.

pals_interdict_2.name: boat
pals_interdict_2.text: Second interdict is done. Now, you two get back!

pals_interdict_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_interdict_2.text: Veddy, you cannot pick us up?

pals_interdict_2.name: sailor
pals_interdict_2.text: They can only go outward from where the interdicts --

pals_interdict_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_interdict_2.text: Too much, too much talking. Yes, yes I see.

pals_asking_about_interdicts_1.name: boat
pals_asking_about_interdicts_1.text: Ask her. I want to see what she says.

pals_asking_about_interdicts_1.name: sailor
pals_asking_about_interdicts_1.text: So... ... What do you make of these interdicts? Why here? Why now?

pals_asking_about_interdicts_1.name: sailor_alt
pals_asking_about_interdicts_1.text: Until you got here, all I *could* do was sit around and think about it.

pals_asking_about_interdicts_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_asking_about_interdicts_2.text: Perhaps they're just old tests, made during initial development of the technique, now forgotten?

pals_asking_about_interdicts_2.name: sailor
pals_asking_about_interdicts_2.text: Wouldn't they be washed to sea by now, or else, piled over?

pals_asking_about_interdicts_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_asking_about_interdicts_2.text: Perhaps they were, and newly uncovered.

pals_asking_about_interdicts_2.name: sailor_alt
pals_asking_about_interdicts_2.text: Yeah, shh, Veddy! Shhh, Veddy, I'm trying to talk.

pals_borrie.name: sailor_alt
pals_borrie.text: Yeah, yeah, okay, okay Veddy, I will.

pals_borrie.name: sailor
pals_borrie.text: She calls her boat Veddy! Ought I call you Borrie from here out?

pals_borrie.name: boat
pals_borrie.text: I've half a runner to take off without you, right this second. I can do that now!

pals_borrie.name: boat
pals_borrie.text: On *my* guidance. And if you stick to doing what I tell you, we'll go far.

pals_farguild.name: sailor_alt
pals_farguild.text: Veddy said we should trust you. So. You have heard the rumors

pals_farguild.name: sailor_alt
pals_farguild.text: of the presumed entity that some call the Farguild,

pals_farguild.name: sailor_alt
pals_farguild.text: for lack of a known name... an empire beyond the Deadwaters?

pals_farguild.name: sailor
pals_farguild.text: Of course! Borrie and I were just discussing the rumors.

pals_farguild.name: sailor_alt
pals_farguild.text: I am not merely surveying. I was sent here with secondary duties.

pals_farguild.name: sailor_alt
pals_farguild.text: To look for evidence of a Farguild incursion. If these interdicts were stolen, we may now have that evidence.

pals_meeting_vedessud.name: sailor_alt
pals_meeting_vedessud.text: Ahh! Long last! Here is my boat, Vedessud. Hey Veddy, did you miss me?

pals_meeting_vedessud.name: vedessud
pals_meeting_vedessud.text: You hardly shut up the whole time, but it's nice to see you again, in the flesh, as it were.

pals_meeting_vedessud.name: vedessud
pals_meeting_vedessud.text: Pleased to meet you finally, Janaila. She's whispered about you a great deal, this past hour.

pals_meeting_vedessud.name: sailor_alt
pals_meeting_vedessud.text: Veddy! That sounded a little impolite.

pals_meeting_vedessud.name: vedessud
pals_meeting_vedessud.text: Oh, I apologize. I just meant ... she was telling me how good you are at solving problems!

pals_meeting_vedessud.name: vedessud
pals_meeting_vedessud.text: She looks up to the Footsailors. But between you and me, I think she'd be an excellent Sailor herself.

pals_meeting_vedessud.name: sailor_alt
pals_meeting_vedessud.text: Veddy! You are making me embarrassed.

pals_rearrival_on_starting_island.name: boat
pals_rearrival_on_starting_island.text: Come talk to me, and let's get going!

pals_talk_to_vedessud_sailor.name: vedessud
pals_talk_to_vedessud_sailor.text: Thanks for all your help! We're almost out of here!

pals_talk_to_vedessud_sailor.name: boat
pals_talk_to_vedessud_sailor.text: All you need to do is come back to me now, and we'll be on our way!

pals_talk_to_vedessud_surveyor.name: vedessud
pals_talk_to_vedessud_surveyor.text: I'm thankful we'll be out of here soon. Great new friends you've made!

pals_talk_to_vedessud_surveyor.name: vedessud
pals_talk_to_vedessud_surveyor.text: Just help her back to her Boat, and we'll be on our way.

pals_sailors_swapped.name: boat
pals_sailors_swapped.text: Oh... what kind of joke is that deckrat putting up, now?

pals_sailors_swapped.name: sailor_alt
pals_sailors_swapped.text: It's fine, it's fine... we'll meet out at sea and do a hot swap.

pals_sailors_swapped.name: boat
pals_sailors_swapped.text: As if today weren't harrowing enough!

pals_sailors_swapped.name: boat
pals_sailors_swapped.text: You're welcome. As you saw, our success hinged on my ability to keep that rapscallion in line!

pals_sailors_not_swapped.name: boat
pals_sailors_not_swapped.text: She seems every bit as inventive and resourceful as you.

pals_sailors_not_swapped.name: boat
pals_sailors_not_swapped.text: But under the surface, there's something odd...

pals_sailors_not_swapped.name: boat
pals_sailors_not_swapped.text: Besides the hair. We'll talk at sea.

magnitudes_intro.name: sailor_alt
magnitudes_intro.text: That's taken care of. Now, it is just time to get out of here.

magnitudes_intro.name: sailor_alt
magnitudes_intro.text: + fog_clear 'exit 0.2 The exit is on the map. It seems somewhat far.

magnitudes_intro.name: sailor_alt
magnitudes_intro.text: But it is my good luck, these beams are all about covering space quickly.

magnitudes_intro.name: sailor_alt
magnitudes_intro.text: + overhead_map_release 2 So this should be easy!

mirror_new_1_start.name: trader
mirror_new_1_start.text: There it is. The first mirror.

mirror_2.name: trader
mirror_2.text: These isles seemed much bigger through the eyes of a boy.

mirror_3.name: trader
mirror_3.text: No ceremony this time. No proctor. Just me and the wind. And the mirrors, of course.

mirror_4.name: trader
mirror_4.text: If I succeed, if I fail, none shall know.

mirror_watcher_first.name: trader
mirror_watcher_first.text: I'd been wondering when I would be met.

mirror_watcher_first.name: trader_alt
mirror_watcher_first.text: + instant_duration 3.08 These are strange times. We've kept quiet.

mirror_watcher_first.name: trader_alt
mirror_watcher_first.text: Well. I'm here to state that we are unoffended by your presence.

mirror_watcher_first.name: trader_alt
mirror_watcher_first.text: You may run the trial as you see fit. I'm here to help.

mirror_oracle_1.name: trader
mirror_oracle_1.text: This is an unswept corner of my life. I always wondered 'what if', you know?

mirror_oracle_1.name: trader_alt
mirror_oracle_1.text: I *do* know. But, it's very unusual that you're here without sanction.

mirror_oracle_1.name: trader_alt
mirror_oracle_1.text: You must have gone to some lengths. What's the urgency?

mirror_oracle_1.name: trader
mirror_oracle_1.text: Well. You see. I'm going to die soon. And I want to know.

mirror_oracle_2.name: trader_alt
mirror_oracle_2.text: Of course, it's a touchy subject, but... you say you're going to die?

mirror_oracle_2.name: trader
mirror_oracle_2.text: I was told so by an Oracle.

mirror_oracle_2.name: trader
mirror_oracle_2.text: Years back, she predicted I'd become the most successful Tradesman. And it has come to pass.

mirror_oracle_2.name: trader_alt
mirror_oracle_2.text: I've no direct experience with the Oracles myself, but they are well-regarded.

mirror_oracle_3.name: trader_alt
mirror_oracle_3.text: Did she give you any details? How you will die, or when?

mirror_oracle_3.name: trader_alt
mirror_oracle_3.text: I'm told there are clues in the words. What did she say, exactly?

mirror_oracle_3.name: trader
mirror_oracle_3.text: The words were: "You will depart this world before the year is out. You must order your affairs."

mirror_oracle_4.name: trader_alt
mirror_oracle_4.text: Are you sure "depart this world" meant die?

mirror_oracle_4.name: trader
mirror_oracle_4.text: What else could she possibly have meant?

mirror_oracle_4b.name: trader_alt
mirror_oracle_4b.text: If she'd meant you would "die", she could have just said that. Oracles are precise, and tricky.

mirror_pre_clones.name: trader_alt
mirror_pre_clones.text: Well. We're finally here. Is it awkward?

mirror_pre_clones.name: trader_alt
mirror_pre_clones.text: This is where you panicked and fled the trial.

mirror_pre_clones.name: trader
mirror_pre_clones.text: Oh. You know who I am?

mirror_pre_clones.name: trader_alt
mirror_pre_clones.text: I was in your cohort, back then. Same is same.

mirror_pre_clones.name: trader_alt
mirror_pre_clones.text: I was the next to run the trial, immediately after you.

mirror_pre_clones.name: trader_alt
mirror_pre_clones.text: When you'd failed, as they were leading you away, I read the contortions on your face, and they told me something.

mirror_pre_clones.name: trader_alt
mirror_pre_clones.text: They gave me a hint at the specific danger I would soon face. I steeled myself against that thing.

mirror_pre_clones_end.name: trader_alt
mirror_pre_clones_end.text: I'll leave you alone for this next part.

clones_early.name: trader_clone_1
clones_early.text: This isn't yet meant to happen.

clones_early.name: trader_clone_1
clones_early.text: Don't develop too big a head. That's all.

clones_first_confusion.name: trader
clones_first_confusion.text: Wish I'd held fast, completed the *original* trial. Become a Mirrorwright.

clones_first_confusion.name: trader_clone_1
clones_first_confusion.text: No no no. We chose the right way. Our success attests to it. On that day, Fear was Wisdom.

clones_triple_confusion.name: trader
clones_triple_confusion.text: I know it's hard, but we must press forward.

clones_triple_confusion.name: trader_clone_1
clones_triple_confusion.text: No no no. We must return at once to manage intake of the week's merchantman.

clones_triple_confusion.name: trader_clone_2
clones_triple_confusion.text: Hassle, hassle. Wife doesn't care for me. Kid is sufficiently raised.

clones_triple_confusion.name: trader_clone_2
clones_triple_confusion.text: Just leave to nowhere special -- become itinerant -- a life of freedom.

clones_working.name: trader_clone_1
clones_working.text: We could work together like this, normally.

clones_merge.name: trader_clone_1
clones_merge.text: Not sure I can do this.

clones_merge.name: trader_clone_1
clones_merge.text: Not sure I want to get through.

mirror_icy_start.name: trader
mirror_icy_start.text: I feel heavy again. A bit cold.

mirror_icy_start.name: trader
mirror_icy_start.text: But there's a fluttering of lightness inside. Clarity.

mirror_pals.name: trader_alt
mirror_pals.text: A portion of the challenge requires work in tandem. I will perform this role.

mirror_pals.name: trader
mirror_pals.text: But you won't clue me in as to --

mirror_stranger_1.name: trader_alt
mirror_stranger_1.text: So, you heard you were going to die... and of all the unfinished business a man might wish to settle,

mirror_stranger_1.name: trader_alt
mirror_stranger_1.text: you decided to come back here? After all these years?

mirror_stranger_1.name: trader_alt
mirror_stranger_1.text: Been thinking about these mirrors a lot, have you?

mirror_stranger_1.name: trader
mirror_stranger_1.text: Not at all. I was ... convinced.

mirror_stranger_2.name: trader
mirror_stranger_2.text: I was convinced, by a stranger.

mirror_stranger_2.name: trader
mirror_stranger_2.text: These days I don't normally drink, but the news that I would soon die weighed on me.

mirror_stranger_2.name: trader
mirror_stranger_2.text: I sought levity in a tavern I'd passed daily,

mirror_stranger_2.name: trader
mirror_stranger_2.text: but whose door I hadn't darkened in many years.

mirror_stranger_3.name: trader
mirror_stranger_3.text: There I met a stranger, fair of complexion.

mirror_stranger_3.name: trader
mirror_stranger_3.text: His mannerisms were odd, as though he'd set foot on many shores,

mirror_stranger_3.name: trader
mirror_stranger_3.text: and come away carrying a bit of each.

mirror_stranger_3.name: trader
mirror_stranger_3.text: His manner of dress presented him as a commoner, but everything he wore was oddly crisp.

mirror_stranger_4.name: trader
mirror_stranger_4.text: The stranger asked my story. Atypically, it all came out.

mirror_stranger_4.name: trader
mirror_stranger_4.text: My shipping empire, which I'd grown slowly, starting from a single modest route,

mirror_stranger_4.name: trader
mirror_stranger_4.text: which I'd established by investing the profit from my humble market stall,

mirror_stranger_4.name: trader
mirror_stranger_4.text: which I started with the pennies I'd hoarded across my youth of doing odd jobs, anything at all,

mirror_stranger_4.name: trader
mirror_stranger_4.text: that young life I'd cobbled from the wreckage of rejection by the Mirrorwrights...

mirror_stranger_4.name: trader
mirror_stranger_4.text: Now a man nearing the end of his allotment, I felt relief as the confessions welled out.

mirror_stranger_6.name: trader
mirror_stranger_6.text: The stranger said that he possessed judgement refined at a level far exceeding the typical man.

mirror_stranger_6.name: trader
mirror_stranger_6.text: He said that this refined judgement permitted him to plainly see that I was wounded in my spirit;

mirror_stranger_6.name: trader
mirror_stranger_6.text: That some broken shard of me lay glinting in the sand of the Mirror Isles,

mirror_stranger_6.name: trader
mirror_stranger_6.text: and that I would never be whole til I went back to reclaim it.

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: The stranger said that even if it were very difficult to eventuate and took lavish expenditure,

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: I should still return to the Mirror Isles and heal my soul.

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: That it was necessary if I were to depart this world a full and self-respecting man.

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: I told him the idea was hopeless. I had too much to manage here, to ensure all would be set right before I'm gone.

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: He said that things seemed right enough with my associates already, and anyway, they all had plenty more time to work with.

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: He said that I was the one with few days remaining to repair my soul.

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: The libations warmed my blood. A plan formed in my mind.

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: I told him it would be fairly inconvenient, and a significant outlay, but ... doable.

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: The early rays of dawn drifted through the window;

mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.name: trader
mirror_stranger_double_mirrors.text: I'd had two drinks too many. I thanked him and took leave.

mirror_stranger_before_hm_1.name: trader
mirror_stranger_before_hm_1.text: I tossed and turned that night, thinking of the mirrors

mirror_stranger_before_hm_1.name: trader
mirror_stranger_before_hm_1.text: and my own shattered glass that, through decades of success,

mirror_stranger_before_hm_1.name: trader
mirror_stranger_before_hm_1.text: I'd tried to reassemble, glue, tape over, but had never truly made whole.

mirror_stranger_before_hm_1.name: trader
mirror_stranger_before_hm_1.text: I knew the stranger was right. A shard was missing.

mirror_stranger_before_hm_3.name: trader
mirror_stranger_before_hm_3.text: Booking passage to the Mirror Isles, as a man with no official business, is, of course, unheard of.

mirror_stranger_before_hm_3.name: trader
mirror_stranger_before_hm_3.text: But I have a fleet of my own. Easy enough to divert a merchantman, whose trades I may not live to see, anyway.

mirror_stranger_before_hm_3.name: trader
mirror_stranger_before_hm_3.text: I charted in my mind the circuitous route we'd take to the Isles to avoid attention.

mirror_stranger_before_hm_3.name: trader
mirror_stranger_before_hm_3.text: By the time the sun had peaked, I'd set the plan in motion.

mirror_deal_1.name: trader_alt
mirror_deal_1.text: I've good news! You're not going to die. At least, not anytime *too* soon.

mirror_deal_1_end.name: trader_alt
mirror_deal_1_end.text: A deal's been struck. Between the Chief Mirrorwrights and ... someone else.

mirror_deal_1_end.name: trader_alt
mirror_deal_1_end.text: There's a special mirror set within a perimeter of polychromic light ...

mirror_deal_2.name: trader_alt
mirror_deal_2.text: There's a special mirror set within a perimeter of polychromic light ...

mirror_deal_2.name: trader_alt
mirror_deal_2.text: the Chiefs say only you can use it, as only you have been invited.

mirror_deal_2.name: trader_alt
mirror_deal_2.text: That is not given me to know.

mirror_deal_2.name: trader_alt
mirror_deal_2.text: You were chosen by the counterparty. More than that is not given me to know.

mirror_deal_2_end.name: trader_alt
mirror_deal_2_end.text: That's the *good* news! You've been invited to ... depart this world.

worlds_collide_HS_start.name: sailor
worlds_collide_HS_start.text: What are those weird red ... energies?

worlds_collide_HS_gates_opened_proximity.name: thief
worlds_collide_HS_gates_opened_proximity.text: I told you this was strange. I told you!!

worlds_collide_HS_gates_opened_proximity.name: sailor
worlds_collide_HS_gates_opened_proximity.text: Hello ... hello there? Could you help me out by skipping a stone back across the water?

worlds_collide_HS_gates_opened_proximity.name: thief
worlds_collide_HS_gates_opened_proximity.text: How'd you put all that water in one place?

worlds_collide_HS_gates_opened_proximity.name: sailor
worlds_collide_HS_gates_opened_proximity.text: This is a lot of water for you?

worlds_collide_HS_end_of_level.name: sailor
worlds_collide_HS_end_of_level.text: I'm Janaila. Good to meet you.

worlds_collide_MP_start.name: trader
worlds_collide_MP_start.text: Hello! Can you cover that light? It's distracting.

worlds_collide_MP_start.name: gemsman
worlds_collide_MP_start.text: That orange tube is very important!

worlds_collide_MP_start.name: trader
worlds_collide_MP_start.text: Well, maybe you can just ... help me out, then.

worlds_collide_MP_start.name: gemsman
worlds_collide_MP_start.text: Maybe you can help me out!

worlds_collide_HP_start.name: gemsman
worlds_collide_HP_start.text: Hello over there! Have you any idea about this ... red ... gate?

worlds_collide_HP_start.name: gemsman
worlds_collide_HP_start.text: It reminds me of something I know, but, it's also different...

worlds_collide_HP_start.name: gemsman
worlds_collide_HP_start.text: Sorry to be a nuisance. But I doubt I have the tools to deal with this, not alone...

worlds_collide_HP_end.name: gemsman
worlds_collide_HP_end.text: God, I hope I see her again.

worlds_collide_HM_start.name: trader
worlds_collide_HM_start.text: Have you any idea where we are?

worlds_collide_HM_start.name: wizard
worlds_collide_HM_start.text: I was about to ask you the same thing!

worlds_collide_HM_start.name: trader
worlds_collide_HM_start.text: It's unusual, but I seem to have an unsolvable problem. I'm stuck!

worlds_collide_HM_start.name: wizard
worlds_collide_HM_start.text: I was about to say the same thing!

worlds_collide_SP_start.name: sailor
worlds_collide_SP_start.text: Not here. A place like here, but, also ... very different!

worlds_collide_SP_start.name: gemsman
worlds_collide_SP_start.text: So then perhaps you know how to get me out of here?

worlds_collide_MS_start.name: trader
worlds_collide_MS_start.text: I'm used to water being more ... placid.

worlds_collide_MS_start.name: sailor
worlds_collide_MS_start.text: Well, if you can placid me onto dry land, I'd appreciate.

mm_why.name: trader_alt
mm_why.text: The Chiefs want you to see this sequence. They said you'll need these ideas where you're going.

mm_why.name: trader
mm_why.text: Where I'm going? I've gone pretty far by now, I thought.

mm_course.name: trader_alt
mm_course.text: We have many sequences, not just that first trial which is known to the public.

mm_course.name: trader_alt
mm_course.text: Initiates usually go through this one around age 16, to validate that they deserve promotion to Apprentice Mirrorwright.

mm_course.name: trader
mm_course.text: I'm honored to be the exception.

mm_course.name: trader_alt
mm_course.text: No exception. They already promoted you to Apprentice Mirrorwright.

mm_merit.name: trader
mm_merit.text: They're promoting me within their College... and I've never even met them?

mm_how.name: trader
mm_how.text: How am I an Apprentice Mirrorwright? I just push these things around. I know nothing about *making* them.

mm_how.name: trader_alt
mm_how.text: It's been foreseen. So they tell me.

beam_shatter_start.name: gemsman
beam_shatter_start.text: Beamcasters! I've got this; it's my home turf.

beam_shatter_start.name: warrior
beam_shatter_start.text: You sure? Looks like my home turf.

beam_shatter_wish.name: warrior
beam_shatter_wish.text: I wish that Druid were here; he could help with these Goblins.

beam_shatter_wish.name: warrior
beam_shatter_wish.text: Oh, you haven't met him yet?

beam_shatter_wish.name: gemsman
beam_shatter_wish.text: I'm not sure. What's he look like?

beam_shatter_wish.name: gemsman
beam_shatter_wish.text: I've met a lot of surly guys.

intro_queen_foreign_script.name: queen
intro_queen_foreign_script.text: Foreign script, but I understand it, somehow.

intro_queen_hosts_1.name: queen
intro_queen_hosts_1.text: Hosts of this place, show yourselves!

intro_queen_hosts_2.name: queen
intro_queen_hosts_2.text: You who call yourselves Sinking Star!

intro_queen_hosts_2.name: queen
intro_queen_hosts_2.text: If you want to help me, send me back to my men.

intro_queen_hosts_3.name: queen
intro_queen_hosts_3.text: The raid must be yet ongoing. I've got to find my way back.

intro_queen_teleporter.name: queen
intro_queen_teleporter.text: Foreign transport, please take me home.

queen_og_ask.name: queen
queen_og_ask.text: I suppose that was too much to ask.

3d_intro_heights.name: sailor
3d_intro_heights.text: Oh my goodness, oh my goodness! Step carefully, Janaila!

3d_intro_heights_end.name: sailor
3d_intro_heights_end.text: Is this what the cityfolk feel like when they say they're 'seasick'?

3d_intro_down.name: sailor
3d_intro_down.text: Yes. We like down, from here.

3d_intro_staircase_mid.name: sailor
3d_intro_staircase_mid.text: I'm not used to it either!

3d_intro_carry.name: sailor_alt
3d_intro_carry.text: Just from here to where we need to go, I mean.

3d_intro_carry.name: sailor_alt
3d_intro_carry.text: Don't let the height phase you. If you don't look, there is nothing there. Simple.

3d_intro_carry_actual_b.name: sailor
3d_intro_carry_actual_b.text: I'm so pent up. No ship to berate.

3d_intro_carry_actual_b.name: sailor_alt
3d_intro_carry_actual_b.text: You know -- I just realized. Me too.

3d_intro_carry_end.name: sailor
3d_intro_carry_end.text: If we're this tricky, no-one can stop us!

hw_first.name: warrior
hw_first.text: I can't believe this is what water is like when it all just ... stays together.

hw_second.name: warrior
hw_second.text: What would happen if I ... fall into that stuff?

hw_warrior_thief.name: thief
hw_warrior_thief.text: So I'm telling you, we'll bring some gourds on a big big cart,

hw_warrior_thief.name: thief
hw_warrior_thief.text: we'll fill them with this 'water', bring the whole cartful back home, and we'll be rich.

hw_warrior_thief.name: warrior
hw_warrior_thief.text: Will the water stay stuck together when we get it back home?

hw_warrior_thief.name: warrior
hw_warrior_thief.text: I don't want to be standing next to a cartload of ... exploding water pellets.

hw_warrior_thief.name: thief
hw_warrior_thief.text: Hmmm, ummm. What if ... we had a *very* long rope ... ?

hw_warrior_thief_end.name: warrior
hw_warrior_thief_end.text: Why exactly would people even buy this water?

hw_warrior_thief_end.name: thief
hw_warrior_thief_end.text: The idle rich buy weird stuff from distant lands all the time. And this is the weirdest!

hw_warrior_thief_end.name: thief
hw_warrior_thief_end.text: Foreign, mysterious ... *maybe* dangerous... it sells itself!

hw_thief_wizard.name: thief
hw_thief_wizard.text: So how does the water stick together?

hw_thief_wizard.name: wizard
hw_thief_wizard.text: I've no idea ... or, rather, so *many* possible ideas that there's no way to narrow them without taking measurements!

hw_thief_wizard.name: wizard
hw_thief_wizard.text: A lot of measurements. And I can't carry my laboratory with me...

hw_warrior_goblins.name: warrior
hw_warrior_goblins.text: I wonder how the goblins feel about all this weird water.

hw_warrior_surrounded.name: warrior
hw_warrior_surrounded.text: A story to tell my grandkids. If I make it out of here ...

hw_warrior_surrounded.name: warrior
hw_warrior_surrounded.text: ... and find a nice girl ... ... and we have kids ...

hw_warrior_going.name: warrior
hw_warrior_going.text: Izzy said there's a chance the exit was in this direction.

hw_warrior_going.name: warrior
hw_warrior_going.text: I'll keep going... But perhaps he's having better luck.

ms_alone.name: trader
ms_alone.text: Here's the thing about the mirrors: they'll make you feel alone.

ms_alone.name: sailor
ms_alone.text: Alone? We're having a good time together, I thought.

ms_alone_2.name: sailor
ms_alone_2.text: Okay. These mirrors can't be too bad, right?

ms_alone_2_end.name: sailor
ms_alone_2_end.text: The mirrors feel ... strangely stilling of the mind.

ms_alone_3.name: sailor
ms_alone_3.text: I haven't been this alone in a long time.

river_dictionary.name: trader
river_dictionary.text: These rivers... I wish she'd told me more about their behavior, before we parted.

mirror_transport_4.name: sailor
mirror_transport_4.text: They're not yours, so who owns the mirrors?

mirror_transport_4.name: trader
mirror_transport_4.text: The ones back home are made by the Mirrorwrights.

mirror_transport_4.name: trader
mirror_transport_4.text: But these -- the Mirrorwrights did not build the place we are now.

mirror_transport_4.name: trader
mirror_transport_4.text: So the mirrors must not be theirs either.

double_agent_intro.name: boat
double_agent_intro.text: Your friend the stranded Surveyor ... you'll be seeing her again soon.

double_agent_intro.name: boat
double_agent_intro.text: The iridescence admits her, like it did you. That's all we know about how and why.

double_agent_intro_end.name: boat
double_agent_intro_end.text: But there's something the Guild knows about her that we need to tell you.

double_agent_intro_end.name: boat
double_agent_intro_end.text: It's ... significant. I'm shocked they held it back this long.

sp_double_agent.name: sailor
sp_double_agent.text: So ... Borraidus told me who you really are.

sp_double_agent.name: sailor_alt
sp_double_agent.text: Did he? I doubt he knows the whole story.

sp_double_agent.name: sailor
sp_double_agent.text: Want to help mend my ignorance?

sp_double_agent.name: sailor
sp_double_agent.text: He told me to trust you anyway, regardless. For now.

sp_double_agent.name: gemsman
sp_double_agent.text: Is there something I should know about?

sp_architecture.name: sailor
sp_architecture.text: This architecture is strange. Makes you wonder who they were.

skipping_near_beams.name: sailor
skipping_near_beams.text: A bit more like home, for once.

skipping_near_beams.name: boat
skipping_near_beams.text: Looking outward a ways, I even see rivers.

skipping_near_beams.name: boat
skipping_near_beams.text: I warn you, though: you're in for a complex time,

skipping_near_beams.name: boat
skipping_near_beams.text: somewhat like the archipelago with that first interdict, where we started this whole journey. It feels so long ago!

sp_wrapping_level_intro.name: sailor
sp_wrapping_level_intro.text: + instant_duration 4.6 Borraidus, what do you make of this? I feel strange about this one.

sp_wrapping_level_intro.name: sailor
sp_wrapping_level_intro.text: + instant_duration 1.52 Okay then. This is the situation.

sp_wrapping_level_intro_mid.name: sailor
sp_wrapping_level_intro_mid.text: Absurd, that a world could be this way.

sp_wrapping_level_intro_end.name: sailor
sp_wrapping_level_intro_end.text: I can't imagine what the Guild will make of this...

sp_rover_mission.name: boat
sp_rover_mission.text: These devices seem to have a simple form of

sp_rover_mission.name: boat
sp_rover_mission.text: what we would consider cybernetic control.

sp_rover_mission.name: boat
sp_rover_mission.text: They steer. And I wonder, could their decision-making apparatus

sp_rover_mission.name: boat
sp_rover_mission.text: be inhabited by a mind such as mine?

sp_rover_mission_end.name: boat
sp_rover_mission_end.text: I've hatched a plan that we must discuss.

sp_rover_mission_end.name: sailor
sp_rover_mission_end.text: Not sure I like the sound of that!

sp_bard_takes_wand.name: bard
sp_bard_takes_wand.text: But we can have fun for a bit.

sp_gem_transport.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport.text: That contraption of yours... I'd expect the struts of such a device to be fashioned from lightweight wood, lacquered,

sp_gem_transport.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport.text: perhaps some metal at the joints, charged stones for motive power;

sp_gem_transport.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport.text: but wood, metal, and stone block these beams and your suit does not.

sp_gem_transport.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport.text: It must be built from materials... exotic and far advanced.

sp_gem_transport.name: gemsman
sp_gem_transport.text: It's made of animal bone, leather, sewn with sinews...

sp_gem_transport.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport.text: Because the beams were made to permeate people, so if the suit's more like a person, ... !

sp_gem_transport.name: gemsman
sp_gem_transport.text: Yes. Our workmen needed to stand inside the beams while wearing the suits.

sp_gem_transport.name: gemsman
sp_gem_transport.text: That's the requirement. The suit is just the design that solves the problem.

sp_gem_transport.name: gemsman
sp_gem_transport.text: Sometimes you end up somewhere that would have seemed weird, beforehand.

sp_gem_transport_end.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport_end.text: You said they 'needed' to stand in the beams... they don't any more?

sp_gem_transport_end.name: gemsman
sp_gem_transport_end.text: That whole way of doing things collapsed. Why it collapsed is a secret.

sp_gem_transport_end.name: gemsman
sp_gem_transport_end.text: We can't build new Beamcasters, any more. I'll get to that, but refurbishing this old suit was the first step!

sp_gem_transport_2.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport_2.text: Hmm. Does this seem familiar to you?

sp_gem_transport_2_end.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport_2_end.text: That contraption of yours... I'd expect the struts of such a device to be fashioned from lightweight wood, lacquered...

sp_gem_transport_2_end.name: wizard
sp_gem_transport_2_end.text: But wood, metal, and stone block these beams...

sp_druid_takes_wand.name: druid
sp_druid_takes_wand.text: I can be a mover, for once. Let's see how that feels.

sp_friendly_nudges.name: gemsman_alt
sp_friendly_nudges.text: I'm honored you let me wear your Mark 2 suit.

sp_friendly_nudges.name: gemsman
sp_friendly_nudges.text: Try not to break it. Now, Let's see how good you are!

sp_warrior_shunt.name: warrior
sp_warrior_shunt.text: So many rocks! Finally, a good workout.

sp_help_drop.name: thief
sp_help_drop.text: So many Crystals! Finally, opportunity for *real* exercise.

sp_help_drop.name: thief
sp_help_drop.text: Come along, contraption friend, we'll take our exercise together.

sp_help_drop.name: thief
sp_help_drop.text: I wonder if you have ... contraption muscles ...

sp_thief_open_beam.name: thief
sp_thief_open_beam.text: These beams make me feel so tingly. Like I could spring any lock in the world.

sp_wizard_open_beam.name: wizard
sp_wizard_open_beam.text: Uff, these beams make me feel ... very tingly. I hope there are no permanent side effects.

sp_warrior_green_beam_end.name: warrior
sp_warrior_green_beam_end.text: You know, I could get used to this.

hp_bard_purple.name: bard
hp_bard_purple.text: I enjoy the color of this light. Soothing.

hp_bard_purple_crystal.name: bard
hp_bard_purple_crystal.text: Come here, shiny one. Let's see what we can do with you.

hp_bard_town.name: bard
hp_bard_town.text: Reminds me of that small town where I first arrived on my visit to the West.

hp_bard_town_mid.name: bard
hp_bard_town_mid.text: The memories drift like finest granules of dust through the air...

hp_bard_town_mid2.name: bard
hp_bard_town_mid2.text: Those three years in the West were such a happy time.

hp_bard_town_mid2.name: bard
hp_bard_town_mid2.text: I was just learning to be an adult, to interact with all these strangers. How to make my way.

hp_bard_market_square.name: bard
hp_bard_market_square.text: Ahh, the market square! I came here every few days in that first year.

hp_bard_market_square.name: bard
hp_bard_market_square.text: Many. And they were very helpful.

hp_endpoint_weapon.name: thief
hp_endpoint_weapon.text: I supppose we're here too late to see the nice parts.

hp_endpoint_weapon.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon.text: Unfortunately, you're right. A hand, please?

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid1.name: thief
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid1.text: Just ... gone ... I *almost* feel bad for the goblins.

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid1.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid1.text: They asked for it, didn't they.

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid2.name: thief
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid2.text: The question though: Did they ravage the town, then transport it here?,

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid2.name: thief
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid2.text: or is this ... a duplicate, timber for timber, built to be burned... and the original remains unscathed?

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid2.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid2.text: We'll find out when we get back home.

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid3.name: thief
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid3.text: I'm sorry if I'm being rude.

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid3.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid3.text: What, why would you think you're being rude?

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid3.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid3.text: It seems to me you're getting a lot done. We work well together.

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid3.name: thief
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid3.text: Well, you don't seem yourself today...

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid4.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid4.text: This destruction has put me in a mood. It feels ... symbolic.

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid4.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid4.text: I don't quite know, and this is what bothers me.

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid5.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid5.text: Happy memories, burned like an old manuscript that was fake;

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid5.name: bard
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid5.text: or a manuscript that was real, but I treated it as a fake.

hp_endpoint_weapon_mid5.name: thief
hp_endpoint_weapon_mid5.text: I don't fully follow, but I'm with you. Let's keep going.

hp_endpoint_weapon_end.name: thief
hp_endpoint_weapon_end.text: I'm glad we had so much time together.

hp_torus.name: thief
hp_torus.text: So, what did Izzy say he was looking for?

hp_torus.name: warrior
hp_torus.text: Can't say I understood. He said, it's a place where the air, the open space, is not that big.

hp_torus.name: thief
hp_torus.text: Like a cave? Or a small room?

hp_torus.name: warrior
hp_torus.text: Like the whole of everything is akin to a small room. He said, it turns around to itself like a doughnut.

hp_torus.name: thief
hp_torus.text: And I do quite well in curvy small rooms...! Even better if I've recently had a doughnut!

hp_torus_2.name: warrior
hp_torus_2.text: Hmmm. This space is not that big... akin to a small room...

hp_torus_2.name: warrior
hp_torus_2.text: Doughnut, though... I don't see it!

hp_torus_3.name: thief
hp_torus_3.text: This doesn't look like a doughnut at all. May be Valens is having more luck.

hp_wizard_torus_1.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_1.text: He spoke of this so casually. But it's incredible!

hp_wizard_torus_2.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_2.text: Little spaces that just... keep repeating...

hp_wizard_torus_2.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_2.text: These would be a wondrous boon for my work! For all of us, I mean...

hp_wizard_torus_3.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_3.text: He spoke of this so casually. But it's incredible!

hp_wizard_torus_3.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_3.text: I asked him about what this meant for magic in his world, but he didn't understand the term.

hp_wizard_torus_4.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_4.text: ... but the strength of magic has always been limited by conflicts seemingly inherent:

hp_wizard_torus_4.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_4.text: The need for energy to cycle, through a medium such as a crystal, in order to compound to decent magnitude...

hp_wizard_torus_4.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_4.text: And the way that turning, so it can loop through the crystal, reduces the speed of energy;

hp_wizard_torus_5.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_5.text: In a place that repeats without curving, this conflict dissolves.

hp_wizard_torus_5.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_5.text: Energy can fly fast and true, and will compound as it repeats and overlaps.

hp_wizard_torus_6.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_6.text: I must learn to create one of these spaces, build an apparatus therein, experiment!

hp_wizard_torus_8.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_8.text: I know Valens cares most about capturing the Magistrate, and the King pretends to care as well,

hp_wizard_torus_8.name: wizard
hp_wizard_torus_8.text: but this could mean more for all of us than any of that political nonsense.

hp_wizard_be_aggro.name: wizard
hp_wizard_be_aggro.text: This is that town our friend the Bard was telling me about.

hp_wizard_be_aggro.name: wizard
hp_wizard_be_aggro.text: Pity she didn't warn me of the goblin infestation.

hp_crystals_not_stones.name: warrior
hp_crystals_not_stones.text: Creepy in here. I'll just get to work to keep my mind off...

hs_island_friends_1.name: sailor
hs_island_friends_1.text: Hello! Good to see you again.

hs_island_friends_1.name: wizard
hs_island_friends_1.text: Why ... hello ... err, perhaps you can show me

hs_island_friends_1.name: wizard
hs_island_friends_1.text: more about these stones. I want to know how they work...

hs_island_friends_2.name: wizard
hs_island_friends_2.text: So, what makes the stones go?
