hs_island_friends_2.name: wizard
hs_island_friends_2.text: What is the nature of this 'motive principle'?

hs_island_friends_2.name: sailor
hs_island_friends_2.text: It's what makes the stones go.

hs_island_friends_3.name: wizard
hs_island_friends_3.text: If, once going, the stone were never to hit anything, would it ever stop?

hs_island_friends_3.name: wizard
hs_island_friends_3.text: What if it's in a place that curves on itself? Connects end to end and top to bottom, somewhat like a ... a doughnut?

hs_island_friends_3.name: sailor
hs_island_friends_3.text: Like a doughnut? The stones don't turn.

hs_island_friends_3_end.name: wizard
hs_island_friends_3_end.text: I don't mean the stone would turn. I mean it would go straight.

hs_island_friends_3_end.name: sailor
hs_island_friends_3_end.text: Then it would fly off the doughnut.

hs_island_friends_3_end.name: wizard
hs_island_friends_3_end.text: No, the doughnut is perfectly straight and goes forever!

hs_warrior_sailor_0.name: warrior
hs_warrior_sailor_0.text: Almost to the meeting point. I hope that girl's okay.

hs_warrior_sailor_1.name: warrior
hs_warrior_sailor_1.text: So, your best friend is a 'boat'.

hs_warrior_sailor_1.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_1.text: Really, 'boat' is a casual term. He's a ship capable of crossing great oceans!

hs_warrior_sailor_1.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_1.text: Well. Sized for me. And the all-important cargo. And, when needed, an extra few passengers for a day or two.

hs_warrior_sailor_1.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_1.text: Certainly you'd never try to fit more people than that.

hs_warrior_sailor_2.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_2.text: The boat is just his body. He himself is a spirit from ... an immaterial place.

hs_warrior_sailor_2.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_2.text: The Guild builds him a body, in return for his services.

hs_warrior_sailor_2.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_2.text: Seeing problems before they become problems. And piloting a ship that goes very, very, very fast.

hs_warrior_sailor_2.name: warrior
hs_warrior_sailor_2.text: We don't have those, but ... where I come from, vehicles are steered by people.

hs_warrior_sailor_2.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_2.text: On open ocean, yes. But threading isles and reefs at speed... I'm only human, good Sir.

hs_warrior_sailor_3.name: warrior
hs_warrior_sailor_3.text: So *before* he gets put into the 'boat', the Guild makes a deal with him?

hs_warrior_sailor_3.name: warrior
hs_warrior_sailor_3.text: And he's a ghost. So your Guild can talk to ghosts?

hs_warrior_sailor_3.name: warrior
hs_warrior_sailor_3.text: How do they talk to the ghosts? ... Spirits?

hs_warrior_sailor_3.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_3.text: It's a channel that requires cooperation on both sides.

hs_warrior_sailor_3.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_3.text: Our side, the Guild side, it's a trade secret, protected fiercely. They don't tell *me* those kinds of details.

hs_warrior_sailor_3.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_3.text: Borraidus' side is a mystery to me. Even just the basics of his life, he's tried to explain several times. I never get it.

hs_warrior_sailor_3.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_3.text: There's nothing there, nothing that we would call a thing. So I don't understand how anything happens.

hs_warrior_sailor_3.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_3.text: But *he* says a lot of things happen.

hs_warrior_sailor_4.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_4.text: ... maybe you'd be interested in the stones' motive principle, then.

hs_warrior_sailor_5.name: sailor
hs_warrior_sailor_5.text: He seemed good. Hope I see him again.

hs_sailor_thief_1.name: sailor
hs_sailor_thief_1.text: You're great at pulling. I'm a bit jealous.

hs_sailor_thief_1.name: thief
hs_sailor_thief_1.text: Thank you, new friend! But... pulling is complicated.

hs_sailor_thief_1.name: thief
hs_sailor_thief_1.text: Pushing is more straightforward, and you don't get surrounded and stuck.

hs_sailor_thief_1.name: thief
hs_sailor_thief_1.text: The way you make the stones zoom forward, that's so neat! I wish *I* could do that.

hs_sailor_druid_1.name: sailor
hs_sailor_druid_1.text: So you can only change things back into what they were? You can't choose?

hs_sailor_druid_1.name: druid
hs_sailor_druid_1.text: I can't choose. They retain their spirit, and I realign form to spirit.

hs_sailor_druid_1.name: sailor
hs_sailor_druid_1.text: I have a friend who's a spirit.

hs_sailor_druid_1.name: druid
hs_sailor_druid_1.text: Oh? Tell me about that some time...

hs_sailor_druid_2.name: druid
hs_sailor_druid_2.text: So your spirit friend, he is a boat, but he wasn't *transmuted* into a boat?

hs_sailor_druid_2.name: sailor
hs_sailor_druid_2.text: No, the boat was built with filaments threaded through the frame. He was bound into those filaments.

hs_sailor_druid_2.name: druid
hs_sailor_druid_2.text: Must be a very special kind of filament.

hs_sailor_druid_3.name: druid
hs_sailor_druid_3.text: All this skipping of stones across the water all day...

hs_sailor_druid_3.name: druid
hs_sailor_druid_3.text: is this a typical activity of your people?

hs_sailor_druid_3.name: sailor
hs_sailor_druid_3.text: The stones are common. The prowess is rare. I'm a specialist, in a privileged position.

hs_sailor_druid_3.name: druid
hs_sailor_druid_3.text: As am I. As am I.

hs_sailor_druid_3_end.name: sailor
hs_sailor_druid_3_end.text: Do you think I could learn what you do?

hs_sailor_druid_3_end.name: druid
hs_sailor_druid_3_end.text: From me? No. From someone else? Officially, no.

vm_thief_priestess_1.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_1.text: The Druid said Aiah was being held back at this old goblin fortress, but insisted he couldn't do anything about it.

vm_thief_priestess_1.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_1.text: He can't do anything?? He's the only guy who can petrify these jerks!

vm_thief_priestess_2.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_2.text: Don't worry, Aiah, I'll find you. There's just a bunch of this 'water' in the way...

vm_thief_priestess_2_mid.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_2_mid.text: Big water, you're my enemy, and my friend. My enemy because, obviously, you're always blocking me.

vm_thief_priestess_2_mid.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_2_mid.text: My friend, because you look and feel so calm. In troubled times, I feel your serenity. It helps me go on.

vm_thief_priestess_3.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_3.text: Aiah, to be honest, I'm a bit jealous of the way you cross water with ease.

vm_thief_priestess_3.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_3.text: It's so much more work for me.

vm_thief_priestess_3_mid.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_3_mid.text: It's so much work for me.

vm_thief_priestess_3_mid.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_3_mid.text: But when I see you just float across... I'm inspired, and I'm all the happier to be your friend.

vm_thief_priestess_4.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_4.text: I'm getting close. The outskirts of the ruins!

vm_thief_priestess_4_mid.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_4_mid.text: I wonder what this building was used for, originally?

vm_thief_priestess_5.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_5.text: Aiah, you're always keeping *me* safe. Who would ever predict that I would come to rescue *you*?

vm_thief_priestess_6.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_6.text: Okay, hold on! I'll get you out!

vm_thief_priestess_7.name: thief
vm_thief_priestess_7.text: We're not quite out of this yet... But all we have to do is get across this bridge!

obf_many_drop_2.name: sailor
obf_many_drop_2.text: Another delicate situation. So much pressure!

obf_monster_drop.name: gemsman
obf_monster_drop.text: Nor I. Their world is so ... deadly. Worst I'd ever worried about was being stuck in an orange beam.

obf_monster_drop.name: sailor
obf_monster_drop.text: Stranded on an island. Not so bad either. Sucked into a giant whirlpool ... okay *that's* bad.

obf_monster_drop.name: gemsman
obf_monster_drop.text: *Or* ... getting rematerialized into a wall. Yeah, that one's bad.

vs_warrior_dragons.name: warrior
vs_warrior_dragons.text: Well. Dragons, I need what you've got.

spin_doctors.name: warrior_alt
spin_doctors.text: Was there supposed to be a problem?

spin_doctors.name: warrior
spin_doctors.text: We're going to have to talk about that. But first let's get this done.

spin_doctors_end.name: warrior_alt
spin_doctors_end.text: You've gotten good at the technique!

spin_doctors_end.name: warrior
spin_doctors_end.text: It's been indispensable. Deep thanks for the lessons!

rotator.name: warrior
rotator.text: Lately I've been getting *so* confused. I don't know where I am, I don't know which direction to go.

rotator.name: warrior
rotator.text: Sometimes it takes a lot of faffing about before I find a good direction.

rotator.name: warrior
rotator.text: But I suppose I haven't *failed* yet.

spin_heroes.name: thief
spin_heroes.text: We came all this way, just to end up in another creepy castle.

spin_heroes.name: warrior
spin_heroes.text: It's more like a creepy temple.

spin_heroes.name: thief
spin_heroes.text: Castle temple. Just get me out of here.

warrior_lonely.name: warrior
warrior_lonely.text: Oh God, I feel so ... lonely.

warrior_lonely_end.name: warrior
warrior_lonely_end.text: Just keep it moving, keep it moving.

3d_intro_mirrors.name: trader_alt
3d_intro_mirrors.text: The Chiefs want me to tell you they think you're doing well.

3d_intro_mirrors.name: trader
3d_intro_mirrors.text: What do they want me to do?

3d_intro_mirrors.name: trader_alt
3d_intro_mirrors.text: Just keep going. When the time comes, we'll give you word.

3d_intro_mirrors.name: trader
3d_intro_mirrors.text: I don't like being kept in the dark.

like_an_isle.name: trader
like_an_isle.text: It's like an isle. Just ... no water. Good thing about that: I can't drown.

like_an_isle_2.name: trader
like_an_isle_2.text: Beautiful. Can't help but wonder what life would be like here.

beautiful_view_warrior.name: warrior
beautiful_view_warrior.text: Beautiful view. I could get used to this.

beautiful_view_thief.name: thief
beautiful_view_thief.text: Beautiful view. Wish I had a friend to see it with me.

thief_promesst_crystals.name: thief
thief_promesst_crystals.text: So, where you come from, you don't have crystals such as these?

thief_promesst_crystals.name: thief
thief_promesst_crystals.text: But you have gems. Gems aren't crystals?

thief_promesst_crystals.name: gemsman
thief_promesst_crystals.text: They're different, I suppose. The gems have a specially-shaped internal lattice, it's part of what stops the beams.

thief_promesst_crystals.name: gemsman
thief_promesst_crystals.text: It's also how the suit manipulates the gems: we slide the lattice.

thief_promesst_crystals.name: gemsman
thief_promesst_crystals.text: These crystals of yours, they must have a different shape on the inside.

thief_promesst_crystals.name: thief
thief_promesst_crystals.text: I just like the way they shine. The gems shine, the crystals shine.

thief_promesst_crystals.name: thief
thief_promesst_crystals.text: Different from each other, each beautiful in its own way.

moment_alone.name: trader
moment_alone.text: I was enjoying my moment alone.

moment_alone.name: gemsman
moment_alone.text: I came to help you, just for a little bit.

moment_alone_2.name: trader
moment_alone_2.text: I suppose I'm glad to have the help.

moment_alone_2_end.name: gemsman
moment_alone_2_end.text: I'll leave you to it, now.

more_than_mirror_guy.name: gemsman
more_than_mirror_guy.text: Personally, I like you a lot more than the mirror guy.

more_than_mirror_guy.name: warrior
more_than_mirror_guy.text: Well... I certainly am more straightforward!

more_than_mirror_guy.name: gemsman
more_than_mirror_guy.text: Not just that. He seems preoccupied somehow. Too buried in his own concerns.

vm_warrior_mirror_guy_1.name: warrior
vm_warrior_mirror_guy_1.text: I don't know, I like the mirror guy fine. I mean yeah, he's quiet sometimes.

vm_warrior_mirror_guy_1.name: warrior
vm_warrior_mirror_guy_1.text: Is that so wrong? One of *our* teammates has never said a word.

vm_warrior_mirror_guy_2.name: warrior
vm_warrior_mirror_guy_2.text: Next time I see him, I'll just tell mirror guy I appreciate his good work. And his insight.

vm_warrior_mirror_guy_2.name: warrior
vm_warrior_mirror_guy_2.text: I know *I* wouldn't mind hearing something like that, once in a while.

vm_warrior_mirror_guy_2_end.name: warrior
vm_warrior_mirror_guy_2_end.text: Especially from one of the ladies...

vm_warrior_mirror_guy_3.name: warrior
vm_warrior_mirror_guy_3.text: I don't think you should be so hard on mirror guy.

vm_warrior_mirror_guy_3.name: warrior
vm_warrior_mirror_guy_3.text: Just ... he brought us these mirrors to solve stuff with. And he understands them very well.

vm_warrior_mirror_guy_3.name: gemsman
vm_warrior_mirror_guy_3.text: Did he bring the mirrors? That would be slike saying you brought the Goblins.

audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.name: acting
audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.text: ... your manners, sir! That look could be taken in quite the wrong way.

audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.text: Forgive me. You are the first person I have seen in ... quite some time.

audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.text: The first person *in* person, I mean, not as a ... figment? What do you call it.

audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.name: acting
audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.text: Let not your heart be troubled. I'm your friend.

audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.name: acting
audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.text: Lift your nose from the grindstone for a bit.

audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.name: acting
audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.text: Walk with me, and I will tell you about the history of this place:

audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.name: acting
audiolog_sky_take_a_tour.text: how it came to be, and why things are the way they are.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: It's much easier to break things than to build them.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: If, God forbid, you perform blind surgery on an organism, not caring what you cut, or how deeply,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: then of course you're going to kill it. Random interventions are almost never beneficial.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: So, what happens when, due to the rapid advances of technology,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: the entire organism of your society undergoes change, after change, after change,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: each coming as you've only started to feel the last?

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: It's impossible to imagine if you haven't been there.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: Suddenly we're incredibly rich, but almost every way we employ these riches

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: becomes deleterious to our well-being, mental *and* physical.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: Imagine the wealthy children of some businessman,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: never had to work for anything in their lives,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: they become snotty, presumptuous, useless, bored,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: believing they are masters of their world with nothing above.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: Nothing to look forward to, no belief in even the *possibility* of meaning that could guide their actions.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: Because they think they're too smart to believe in meaning.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: "Maybe drugs will give me some reprieve," and we have oh *so* many drugs.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: They set about destroying body, mind, and spirit in plausibly-deniable ways.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: When that gets boring, well, why not toy with our weapons of incredible power;

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: turn them on anyone who looks at you askance. Maybe you'll feel better.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: Technology keeps advancing, and soon provocations become unnecessary.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: Someone was feeling bad today, so he set off a bomb or unleashed a disease

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: just to see a million souls squirm and die. To vent upon them his rage. His rage at being nothing.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: There were enough such people to wreck our world;

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: too many of our contemporaries are not much better.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: These were, and are, dangerous times, and I thank God that I've survived inaswell as I have.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: Though it's not been without incident for me, either.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_1.text: So, what made you different from the other rich children?

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: So, what made you different from the other rich children?

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: As I said, I thank God. Beliefs can keep you anchored. They have survival value.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: They prevent the world becoming meaningless in your mind.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: And when founding an organization that keeps a population afloat with its laws and mores,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: beliefs provide enough structure to hold your vessel together, that it be not broken by the waves.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: For Man in the state of primitive Nature, life is an onslaught of constraints and limitations.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: You can barely survive, so long as you do this, then that, and that.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: Perilous as this existence may be for any individual man,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: the constraints form a container that protects humanity as a whole.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: But in response to all the peril, we developed technology.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: In mastering Nature, we removed the constraints. No more container. A turtle without its shell.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: So you need to replace the shell. You need a boat with enough of a hull to stay above the water.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: Only then can you think about sailing it somewhere.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_2.text: Various new societies had different ideas how to accomplish this. Our Order is one such.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: We don't require our members to believe anything specific.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: Many of our founders have beliefs you would call religious, or "spiritual".

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: Some others don't, but they understand

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: that the structure and machinery of the Order were created according to these beliefs.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: "It's in the water", as they say.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: (The water that we drink, that is.)

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: Overall, belief is one of the primary reasons our Order has survived.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: But without a reason to be that transcends human whim,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: we'd have dissolved like so many other of the Lifeboat societies.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: Like the one I was born into.

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: Because even if you make a boat out of rules,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: if everyone knows the rules are arbitrary, why *not* break them, if it feels good in the moment?

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: How would you get everyone to observe arbitrary, meaningless, unbacked rules for even a single century?

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: Many societies chose to be less-structured and to rely on the good judgement of their members,

audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_lifeboat_societies_3.text: but if you want to know how well they worked, good luck finding anyone to ask.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: The very earliest Warehouses did not combine worlds, as these do. They were collections

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: of individual elements mixed together: a handful of objects, a handful of behaviors.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: As the Order's abilities grew, they put more things together at a time.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: Beyond a certain size, the outcomes tended towards inscrutability.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: Some further structure was wanted, to help create clear and visible patterns in the Visitor's mind.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: So they got the idea to borrow multiple elements from a single world at once, and then to combine those worlds.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: This was around when I showed up.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: The Warehouses, that brought two worlds together, we came to call 2-combiners.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: We did a lot of those. They provided for very clear focus.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: The High Implementors discussed ways of achieving more interconnectedness,

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: but for a long time we couldn't manage it -- attempts at higher degrees of combination would just produce a mess.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: Over time, though, we got better. Eventually 3-combiners became achievable, then popular, then standard.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: The leap to 4 happened much later.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: Each time you increase the number of worlds, the number of invisible connections rises disproportionately;

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: in the limit it's 2 to the nth power, where n is the number of ideas across all the worlds.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: So it's hard to keep pushing upward.

audiolog_sky_combiners.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners.text: But doing hard things is the reason we are here.

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: By now, we've done a lot of 4-combiners.

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: We topped out at 4, more or less, for a long while.

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: When I oversaw the building of this Warehouse, I was just following the established pattern,

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: but filling it in a bit differently, applying the best of what I knew.

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: The 4-combiner had become a well-worn template, a path too-frequently trodden, perhaps.

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: The very day we broke ground for this Warehouse, Director -- the Director of the Static Brigade --

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: and Lemur too, announced that for the next facility, we would try something new and big.

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: The 250th anniversary of our Order had arrived;

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: and coincidentally, the serial numbers of the Warehouses were about to reach an arcane and auspicious number.

audiolog_sky_combiners_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_2.text: There's a bit of an inside joke that few understood except Lemur, Director and some other Highests.

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: So, celebrate. A more-ambitious Warehouse, of a scale heretofore unimagined!

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: What form should it take? We'd been in a rut of 4-combiners for a while, so a 5-combiner was the obvious next step.

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: But Lemur didn't like the idea. "Too small," he said, and also, "poor symmetry!"

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: See, once we had gotten to 4-combiners we liked them a lot better than 3;

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: the 4-way symmetry splays itself nicely across a two-dimensional map,

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: and besides the practicality of that, it also *celebrates* the dimensional axes in a way.

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: Because the mathematics of space are so fundamental to what we do, 4-way symmetry feels good.

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: A 5-combiner doesn't flatten out nicely into that symmetry,

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: but a *6-combiner* would be nice because it expands into the third dimension,

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: so we now position one world in the positive and negative direction along each axis.

audiolog_sky_combiners_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_3.text: For these reasons, we did strongly consider a 6-combiner.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: But Lemur still said "No!" Director agreed. And many of us saw their point.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: A 6-combiner would be significantly more ambitious than 4, but could plausibly be completed by

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: a mid-sized group of Implementors, say, one or two hundred.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: So, what if we went bigger than that? What if we declared a project so audacious, it required all hands for any hope of completion?

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: (One of the reasons we had topped out at 4-combiners was the tradition of having one or a few designers authoring the whole Warehouse;

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: which we did feel was very important for a long time. But part of this decree was to change the way we did things.)

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: We were tired of plodding forward, and our membership was dwindling.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: Let's give people a real challenge, something so ambitious, bordering on insane,

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: that minds who had gone gray and dull would be reinvigorated even just hearing about such a thing.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: Teach them to yearn for the vast and endless sea.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: We didn't want safe. We wanted to break through to the next level.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: As our Director put it, we wanted to fashion our own small Leviathan, an endeavor at which we might truly suffer failure;

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: to test ourselves as individuals, and to test the Order as a whole.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: So. Another of the Highest Implementors suggested stepping it up to an 8-combiner, with hierarchical structure.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: It'd be shaped as two 4-combiners like this Warehouse we're in,

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: but after exploring one entire 4-combiner, and then the other, 8 worlds in total,

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: you'd reach the bridge where they connect to each other.

audiolog_sky_combiners_4.name: acting
audiolog_sky_combiners_4.text: "I like the way you're thinking," Lemur said --

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: "I like the way you're thinking," Lemur said --

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: but why stop there? We've found that symmetry does good things for us, so why stop at the partial symmetry of a two-by-four barbell?

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: "Keep going!" He prompted us to think about *full* symmetry: a 4-combiner of 4-combiners.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: We would constuct 4 entire Warehouses, each like in size to this one;

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: and, just like the worlds combine in a cross pattern *here*,

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: that same cross pattern would occur again, writ large, and mix the 4 sub-facilities.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: The magnitude of the leap was absurd, but Lemur was finally happy with the idea.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: And we all had to admit, it just looked right. So, that's the way we went.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: It was an incredibly difficult project that truly required all hands.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: It did reinvigorate the group; many souls we’d not seen in decades re-emerged from obscurity, smiling wide.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: As for myself, I had only just begun to design this very Warehouse in which we stand.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: Even so, I and my assistants felt the need to participate. We worked sometimes here, sometimes there.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: I hadn't seen anyone work so hard since the early days.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: We were making good progress. Then, we hit a wall.

audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.name: acting
audiolog_sky_tetratetrad.text: We'd thought we understood holography quite well, but the Holographic Principle still held surprises.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: ... and if you're trying to achieve clarity, then, why's this place so big?

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: To be blunt, it was a disorienting place to land. Would have preferred something smaller!

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: For a long time, every Warehouse we built was much smaller than this.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: As we refined our art, they got bigger.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: Even so, some Implementors today still like to keep it simple

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: and build places smaller, and more focused, than they *could* do.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: But I think, if we're here to study our very prolific universe,

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: well, if you stay in the shallows, you won't learn to swim. Not as well. Not under harrowing circumstances.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: You do have water that permits you to float, yeah? That metaphor makes sense to you?

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: Good. It's not a given... as you've seen, two of these worlds have no water at all.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: Anyway, yes, this Warehouse is bigger than most. And it was pretty hard to make.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: Even so, we left some things out. It could have been bigger, "should" have been bigger perhaps.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: But this was the very limit of what I could do after 10 years of work.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big.text: Had I known it could be my last, I might have kept pushing.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.text: This Warehouse is one of the more audacious of the 4-combiners.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.text: The North and West worlds here are quite bold -- they import a large number of objects and behaviors

audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.text: In contrast, the worlds in the East and South only bring in a few objects and behaviors each,

audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.text: which is more typical. But with the North and West, I was feeling frisky.

audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.name: acting
audiolog_sky_why_so_big_3.text: Getting together all those elements in the North was very difficult to eventuate... and took lavish expenditure, I must say.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: sokoban
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: I'd been spare with them of late. I felt I should save the last few beacons for emergency purposes.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: I find them fun to listen to. We used to do a similar thing. You could say it was a tradition.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: sokoban
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: I left my recordings that I might be followed.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: sokoban
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: But you own this place; for what purpose would you leave beacons?

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: It's not the 'beacon' part, but the way you record a monologue. For us, the practice goes way back;

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: it was established by the primitive arts from which, eventually, our current work evolved.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: The old thing was a form of entertainment, usually. You would be exploring some territory;

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: you'd come upon a narrated recording left for you by some fictional character.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: You listen to it, then explore more, find another. Then another.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: These recordings would tell you about the character, his thoughts, and the setting as a whole.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: What they used to term "world-building", funny to think. We'd have to call it differently now.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: When our Order began its own work, their constructions were not too unlike these old entertainments,

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: highly fictionalized, so they used a similar technique. Over time it blossomed into something more direct.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: In my own works, I appreciated that these recordings, when well-made, helped to focus and direct the Visitors.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: It's useful to hint to them about what exactly is going on, why all this is here.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: sokoban
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: But you stopped making them?

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: The recordings are supposed to be interesting,

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: to shed light on what we're doing in a way that's unique and alive. But ...

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: The recordings are supposed to be interesting, to shed light on what we're doing in a way that's unique and alive.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: But, it's hard to stay fresh after hundreds of works ...

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: How do you keep finding new ideas that are really worth hearing?

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: It's difficult to avoid falling into a rut of repeatedly saying the same things, using slightly different words each time.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: That's not merely dull for us; for the Visitor it feels flat and uninspired.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: The perceptive ones will see, as we do, that it diminishes the work.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: The mechanism by which we combine these worlds constantly generates fresh material.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: We'll talk about this further, I'm sure.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: But we find the freshness of the material outpaces what we have to *say* about the material. So we generally agreed, better to stop.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: High Implementors still do make recordings on occasion, when they find something new to say.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: Today I suppose I've got a bee in my bonnet.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: This discussion is long enough that I'll split it into pieces, and place them appropriately.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: There are tactics determining good placement that you should know.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: We leave the first part in an easily-accessible place,

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: to introduce the discussion as the player enters the area;

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: what we're saying now will be the second part, and we'll leave it in a location that must be deliberately earned,

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: but that is plainly visible on first entry.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: That gives the Visitor a goal to work toward ... if he's interested.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: Our Order was founded from the meeting of two old 'spiritual' traditions, together with a newer one that's more like your own Natural Philosophy.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: I'll enjoy hearing about that last one.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: Let's start with the woo-woo, then! These traditions go back, say, three or four thousand years;

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: and they each shed a different light on a similar fundamental idea:

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: that the Universe is engaged in a Play of Form; a constant, effortless action, performed out of the sheer fullness of being.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: A child becomes an adult becomes an old man, a wild storm whips through the trees, this nation goes to war with that nation:

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: all aspects of this play of form, of possibilities playing out.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: The important idea to take into the rest of this discussion

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: is that the Universe *wants* to explore different forms;

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: it's not a dead and lifeless progression through time, but somehow abundant and surprise-generating.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: Now, we get to the part that you'll like more: the methods of the understanding of Natural Law.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: When our civilizations were young, we might have thought the laws were simple:

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: the sun rises at regular intervals, the tides cycle, objects fall downward and break.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: But as our sciences advanced, we found that we could refine our notions of these laws,

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1.text: making them successively more specific and accurate: the laws of physics, chemistry, astronomy, and so on.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: ... the laws of physics, chemistry, astronomy, and so on.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: So, what is Law? When viewed from inside Time,

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: the physical Law consists of a set of rules, not unlike the rules of a game:

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: when thing A and thing B interact, and the properties of A and B

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: are in such and such a way, the rulebook tells you the result.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: Repeat these rules over and over, and that's physics happening, or chemistry, or any other set of laws you can codify.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: Population dynamics, the spread of disease.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: Indeed.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: Rules operate on the current state of the world, and give us a new state of the world.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: We would say they map state to state.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: But rules don't *dryly* map state to state.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: When the rules are chosen just right, they generate. They create consequences that are bountiful and sometimes deeply surprising.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: And that brings us back to those spiritual traditions that say that the Universe is exploring form as an aspect of its own joy.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: Our tradition is a descendant of those. We carry it on by seeing this Play of Form as the blooming of lawful possibility:

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: the creative explosion that happens as a result of rules operating on state.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: When a Mirror and a Skipping Stone come together, and the result generates newness and surprise,

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: we observe this as a specific instance of the Universe's ever-unfolding process of creation.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: We look with wide eyes; we try to submerge ourselves, soaking it up.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: Somehow the Universe *wants* the Mirror and the Skipping Stone to play together.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: When we bring these two elements near each other, some kind of potential is released:

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: this big explosion of possibility happens, and generates surprising ways for Mirror and Stone to interact.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: And we sift through, we find the consequences that are most delightful and beautiful, or just unexpected,

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: and we frame them, to help Visitors like yourself appreciate this unfolding.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: That's the why of all these puzzles. The puzzles draw frames around specific instances of unfolding.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: And many instances, well-displayed together, fill out a rich, multidimensional image in our minds.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: You see the similarities between one behavior and another.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: You see the differences. You notice unique moments that seem to communicate something special, that defies verbalization.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: From a constellation of examples, we build in our awareness

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: a vision of the Play of Form that we'd never achieve otherwise.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: I'll do what I can to take note of these ideas.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: You don't have to believe them. A decent fraction of the Order does not!

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: But your job for now, ignoring what anyone believes or doesn't believe,

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: is just to open your eyes *really wide* and just *see* it. Just see the phenomena.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: I can do that. Seeing objectively is the foundation of Natural Philosophy, after all.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: Good. We'll speak again, after you've explored a bit further.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: See you later, Alligator.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1a.text: What ... what?

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: We play one specific situation, after another, after another. We learn to generalize.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: Then we go again. Finished that Warehouse, on to another. More puzzles.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: We see specifics. We learn how to generalize between them. We absorb, to our current capacity, the Way of Creation.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: We meditate on what we have seen. Then we go again. Another ten Warehouses, another hundred.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: We meditate deeply on what we have seen. We absorb, to our now-increased capacity, the Way of Creation.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: And there's an outer cycle as well. The better we play and absorb,

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: the better-built are the Warehouses we construct, the better the experiences of our Visitors.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: We have a special meditation wherein we take the knowledge we've internalized and expand it outward,

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: meeting the world with what we know. Seeing the world in a new way.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: Being *inside* the world in a new way.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: In the beginning we perform these meditations seated, eyes closed.

audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.name: acting
audiolog_sky_play_of_form_1b.text: Eventually you can do them eyes open, just walking around.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: There's an ancient book of our people -- it was reassembled from scraps, so never fully reliable --

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: but it describes the universe emerging from a fundamental whole underlying everything we see.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: First, somehow, this whole, the Dao, gives rise to One.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: We'll be simplistic for now and think of this as the Dao identifying itself.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: This is deeply questionable, but we have to start somewhere. Anyway.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: Then, the book says, One produces two, two produce three, and three produce all the ten thousand things --

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: all that we observe in Creation.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: The text is mysterious and minimal; but combined with what we've already discussed,

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: you can guess the Order's angle.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: Rather than just accepting the results of this creative process, can we look at it more closely?

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: Can we create a microscope to help us zoom in

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: and look at the Dao in all its particular details, to understand how this creative process works?

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: Some of us still think the answer is No.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: We have an idea that our universe began with an immense explosion.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: We did too, once. And, well, to physical appearances it somewhat did ... but when you look at underlying mechanisms, they are not so unstable.

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: If you want an image, you can think of this Dao business as describing an explosion that created the Universe,

audiolog_sky_10000_things.name: acting
audiolog_sky_10000_things.text: but, somewhere more fundamental. Any physical explosion is just a surface echo.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: If the recording is short, too short to be a satisfying reward on its own,

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: don't put it in a hard-to-reach place. We mustn't disappoint!

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: Just put it in an easy place, and it will feel like a small gift,

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: because you're acknowledging the Visitor's progress to a new area.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: Regarding your own recordings... normally they would be considered foreign objects

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: and would be automatically removed upon your exit.

audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.name: acting
audiolog_s_tradition_of_our_people_part_.text: But today, I'll allow it. They're nice. They help the place feel lived-in.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: and eventually, the day came for me to rise in rank, from Sokoban to Implementor. You do this by creating your own Warehouse for the first time.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: Something small. Not too fancy. Enough to show you know the basics.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: + instant_duration 2.8 But, of course, I wanted *mine* to be special.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: As part of our training, we must play through all the major works of the Founders.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: First Founder Lemur's Warehouses all began the same way. At the entrance, right before you start, one of these recordings.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: But, not a fictionalized recording. Rather, a cryptic reading --

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: from a poem, half of nonsense, about a monster that makes people disappear --

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: Of course recordings can be copied, but each time, Lemur voiced a fresh recording of the same text.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: + instant_duration 8.5 I felt I came to understand, from reading to reading, the subtle secret meanings behind each pause, each lowering of the voice.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: The man who is still the official Director of the Static Brigade

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: used to read a selection of verse about a giant sea monster,

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: from one of our religious texts -- I do like that one.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: But the newer members (I say "newer", though they were all senior to me), the newer members didn't do any of this.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: You walked into their facilities, it was just, basic instructions and help, and let's go.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: Perhaps they felt they didn't rank highly enough to put on such a show. That it would be presumptuous.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: + instant_duration 4 I think also, they were worried about embarrassing themselves.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: Well. Before I had even reached the rank of Implementor, headstrong me decided I would be ... just like the Founders.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: I practiced 'til I performed my invocation well, and I placed it in just the perfect spot.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: What I had done felt true. I was happy with it.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: But, people talked. Some said I sounded pretentious and hollow.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: And maybe I was, a little. But we all have to start somewhere.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: Chin up, shoulders set, I continued this practice of invocation for a while, as my Warehouses grew more sophisticated.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: Can't just stop and show the gossips that they were right!

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: But over time, eventually, I fell out of the practice. I suppose I felt I'd outgrown it.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: Or perhaps I'd let the gossips win after all.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: Though today, speaking with you, I feel reinspired. For the first time in many, many years, I'm going to re-record my invocation. I'd be pleased if you listen, and watch me do so.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: I will place it in the entryway to this Warehouse,

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: the last I was able to create, and the first I will soon pass over to you.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: My prayer is a small excerpt from a very old poem.

audiolog_sky_invocation.name: acting
audiolog_sky_invocation.text: With it, I have reopened a part of myself I'd kept shut away for a very long time. Take care of it through your tenure.

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: sokoban
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: ... and though it feels uncouth to say outright, I must admit: the prospect of greatly prolonging my own life is ... quite a temptation.

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: acting
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: + instant_duration 6.55 That's not surprising. But long-term, if you're here for inauthentic reasons, it'll become obvious...

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: acting
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: Oh. Look who we have here.

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: magistrate
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: As you requested, I've been working at the four-four.

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: magistrate
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: Attempting to mend connections that have broken, and so forth.

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: magistrate
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: I at least had to be judged worthy of an invite. But, welcome.

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: magistrate
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: There is an option there. We should talk about it.

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: magistrate
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: You'll surmise this means I have connected back to your home. Which I have.

audiolog_s_magistrate.name: magistrate
audiolog_s_magistrate.text: You can leave any time you want! From your diaries, it seems you're quite eager.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: acting
audiolog_sky_wool.text: ... and some things just require immediate attention. Imagine that any single lunatic can unleash destruction, at a whim, across an entire city -- and the surrounding area --

audiolog_sky_wool.name: acting
audiolog_sky_wool.text: and this has already happened a few times, and the trend is accelerating.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_wool.text: I would regard that with the gravest apprehension. I should think it wise to remove myself some distance away.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_wool.text: If you'd already developed the means of creating new volumes of space, that would have been a great help, I imagine.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: acting
audiolog_sky_wool.text: The techniques were in their infancy, but there was tremendous motivation.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: acting
audiolog_sky_wool.text: So we got there. Create space, tweak its rules, move into the new house, close the door behind.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: acting
audiolog_sky_wool.text: Reopen the door just a crack, once in a while, for carefully-scheduled rendezvous.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: acting
audiolog_sky_wool.text: And well that we got out, as the planet was soon gone; though the people of the time were surprised it lasted as long as it did.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: acting
audiolog_sky_wool.text: Zoom out, and it's spatial steel wool. It's a serious challenge to make maps, even of the well-known parts.

audiolog_sky_wool.name: acting
audiolog_sky_wool.text: And the scope of such maps is limited. Here, space is mostly private, mostly unknown to any individual.

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: Welcome back, Acting Director.

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: Thank you, Sokoban.

end1_dimension_0.name: queen
end1_dimension_0.text: Hail! Hail, who speaks?

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: I see you've performed the reconnection quite well.

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: Our Visitor hasn't been waiting but a handful of seconds.

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: Did my best.

end1_dimension_0.name: queen
end1_dimension_0.text: Hello! Where ... where are you?!

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: It's been a while since we last spoke.

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: 16 months' proper time, yesterday.

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: You must be working hard.

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: There's a lot to learn yet. And I'm spending a decent amount of time back in this Warehouse.

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: Doing what I can to keep it standing. This place needs a lot of help.

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: Don't I know it.

end1_dimension_0.name: queen
end1_dimension_0.text: You who are speaking, make answer! You are Sinking Star?

end1_dimension_0.name: queen
end1_dimension_0.text: Address me directly! Whence do you speak?

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: Sokoban, busy as you've been, surely you were informed of the new rule

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: that we mustn't speak directly with any Visitor of insufficient rank,

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: regardless of any upset this may cause.

end1_dimension_0.name: queen
end1_dimension_0.text: (sigh)

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: Is that all on my account?

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: I did enjoy our conversations, but they caused a kerfuffle.

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: Apologies.

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: None needed. It was supposed to have been the rule already.

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: As the seniormost present officer of the Order of the Sinking Star,

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: + unfreeze 5.5 I declare this Appreciation Ceremony ... commenced. Free the zeroth block!

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: We begin with four points.

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: Heroes, Mirrors, Stones, Beams.

end1_dimension_0.name: acting
end1_dimension_0.text: Simple points of dimension zero.

end1_dimension_0.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_0.text: One by one, visit and observe.

end1_dimension_1.name: acting
end1_dimension_1.text: It's quite nice having unexpected Visitors, though we invited neither of you.

end1_dimension_1.name: acting
end1_dimension_1.text: We'll have to figure out how that's happening. Decay-related, possibly. Regardless, I wouldn't mind more of it.

end1_dimension_1.name: acting
end1_dimension_1.text: Then by what method did she get here? Could matter a lot.

end1_dimension_1.name: acting
end1_dimension_1.text: Two points, connected, determine a line.

end1_dimension_1.name: acting
end1_dimension_1.text: Each line defines a continuum, a dimension, where before there was none.

end1_dimension_1.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_1.text: Now ascend, from dimension zero, to dimension one.

end1_dimension_1.name: acting
end1_dimension_1.text: + unfreeze Trace the lines and connect the worlds.

end1_dimension_2.name: acting
end1_dimension_2.text: How do you find it, watching an Endgame from this perspective?

end1_dimension_2.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_2.text: Well ... exhilarating, really. *Quite* different from playing it down there.

end1_dimension_2.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_2.text: But I have to say, I don't understand all the ancillary data I'm seeing.

end1_dimension_2.name: acting
end1_dimension_2.text: Three points define three lines that trace a boundary,

end1_dimension_2.name: acting
end1_dimension_2.text: and thus delimit an area, a spread of two dimensions.

end1_dimension_2.name: queen
end1_dimension_2.text: Might you please just ... speak with me plainly?

end1_dimension_2.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_2.text: Wandering each area, visit any mix of its worlds that you choose to explore.

end1_dimension_2.name: acting
end1_dimension_2.text: + unfreeze Four worlds generate four such spreads, and only four.

end1_dimension_3.name: acting
end1_dimension_3.text: Do you remember these Solutions, from back when it was your turn?

end1_dimension_3.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_3.text: Though I've been to quite a few Warehouses since, I make it a rule to replay this one after every third.

end1_dimension_3.name: acting
end1_dimension_3.text: Really? Eventually, you'll find that too much.

end1_dimension_3.name: acting
end1_dimension_3.text: Everything gets old at some point. But, keep with it for now.

end1_dimension_3.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_3.text: You entrusted this Warehouse to me. Best I know it intimately.

end1_dimension_3.name: acting
end1_dimension_3.text: Four points, taken all at once, give rise to dimension 3, unique.

end1_dimension_3.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_3.text: Six lines for its edges, four trigons, its sides.

end1_dimension_3.name: acting
end1_dimension_3.text: A pyramid standing before the dawn of time, its volume hides mysteries;

end1_dimension_3.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_3.text: + unfreeze A simplex, thick with worlds in play; roam within their rich display.

end1_dimension_4.name: sokoban
end1_dimension_4.text: Through the years, as you continue,

end1_dimension_4.name: acting
end1_dimension_4.text: what you've seen will live within you.

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: We're here to look at the way things combine. At first, when exploring a Warehouse like this one, you see specific objects:

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: A Mirror behaves in a certain way, teleporting objects to equidistant positions.

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: You observe the basic behavior, you do some solving with it,

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: see how it interacts in various permutations;

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: with time and practice the Mirror's behavior becomes natural to you.

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: A Skipping Stone: it skips over water, it will land on shore or it will sink, and you do it again:

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: basic solving, working with the stone's behavior until it becomes natural.

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: When we put the Mirror and the Skipping Stone together, you see the mysterious force begin to act:

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: the two objects, brought into proximity, *complexify* with each other.

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: The Stone likes to travel in one direction, so *now* when the Mirror acts, it acts

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: not just on the Stone's position, but this direction as well.

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: That creates new situations of interest, which we illustrate by making new puzzles.

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: Oh, look, the Mirror *changes* the direction. What if the new direction happens to be vertical, the one axis affected by Gravity?

audiolog_sky_complexification_1.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_1.text: This complexification goes both ways. The Stone can make some things happen to the Mirror as well -- as you may see eventually.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: Now if you want to visualize the blooming of possibility, it helps to consider that each world begins with *more* than one object.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: For simplicity, to start, imagine each world just had *two* things.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: One world has a Thief and a Goblin; another world has Gems and a Beam That Lets You Walk Through Walls.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: We draw these relationships. For Thief we draw a dot, and Goblin is a dot,

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: and the interaction between Thief and Goblin is a line that connects them.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: Same in the other world: a line connects Gem and Beam. I'll draw this out for you. It's only two lines so far; keep that number two in mind.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: Now, we put all four of these objects, from both worlds, into the same place.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: With the objects that were already old friends, nothing happens; we already saw how they work, and it stays the same.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: But any two objects from *different* worlds, who have never met, want to play together now.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: Here, we see four new interactions: Gem interacts with Thief, and also with Goblin; that's two more lines.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: And Through Beam interacts with Thief, and also Goblin; that's two more lines as well.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: I'll draw those in red. You don't have to go the other way, because Gem with Thief

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: is the same as Thief with Gem, at least for our purposes here.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: So we started with just two lines. But now we have six lines,

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: without adding any new objects. We merely brought together things that we already had.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: It is this moment of intercombining, and the resultant expansion,

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: that we watch carefully. It's the whole reason we build these Warehouses.

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: We're interested in this, because this is a basic aspect of Reality:

audiolog_sky_complexification_2.name: acting
audiolog_sky_complexification_2.text: Reality is always combining the elements we *already have* and producing things *never before seen*.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: There's another work from our canon, that takes inspiration

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: from the Daoist tradition, but puts a mathematical spin on it.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: You'll recall that first the Dao creates or gives rise to One, One creates Two, and so on.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: So we want to look at the idea of going from nothing that is identifiable,

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: to one identifiable thing, to many identifiable things.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: So let's consider the idea of Distinction -- lines being drawn to distinguish things from each other.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: sokoban
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: You're saying distinguish instead of create -- so the things are already created?

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: It's a different picture of creation. I said "nothing that is identifiable",

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: but don't imagine this as physical nothingness. More like an all-pervading potential.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: An undifferentiated whole has no need for distinction.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: But once we say there is One, this necessarily involves a distinction:

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: between that One, and whatever that One is not.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: To model this mathematically, the author began with what he called the First Distinction.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: This Distinction means that now we have two things, A and Not A.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: Once you have a boundary, this admits the possibility of crossing the boundary.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: You can cross from A to Not A, or from Not A to A.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: On a more human scale, perhaps Alive to Dead, then back to Alive. Contented to Bored, then back to Contented.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: You can write crossings mathematically, where a single right-angled mark both

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: states that there is a distinction, and also says "I crossed it".

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: And then, you can introduce two rules for manipulating what you wrote.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: If you cross and cross back again, you end up where you started -- that's the same as staying still.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: Likewise in reverse. Anywhere you stood still, in other words wrote nothing,

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: you can replace this with crossing and then crossing back,

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: which looks like one right-angled mark inside another.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: And marking down the same distinction twice is the same as marking it once...

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: you are just saying the same thing twice, redundantly.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: (This looks like two right-angled marks next to each other.)

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: So anywhere you wrote a distinction, you can write it twice, three times, however many you want.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.text: With just these two rules of rewriting, a tree can blossom that is huge, as large as you like.

audiolog_sky_laws_of_form.name: acting
